review: The staff (family), were amazing and very kind. They also recommend where to go and where to eat. One of the restaurants they recommended was the best we had in all of Italy - Bell'Assai. The location is excellent!!! We highly recommend this hotel!
Loved the quiet park setting, fabulous pool area and large elegant restaurant and rooms. Nothing really. It was a 30 minute walk to Ortigia., but we knew that when we booked.

Everything was great. The hosts were friendly, responsive, and provided helpful recommendations. It was a short 6-minute walk to the port. Lots of great food options nearby. The location was excellent, and check-in times were flexible.
Beautiful authentic character, appartment on the top floor of a three story walk up in the heart of Tivoli
This is a great place run by amazing hosts.

What we liked is that the owner seemed to care about the place (in comparison with the neighboring units). The walls were freshly painted. All floors nicely tiled. The patio with the sun umbrella and the lemon tree providing a lot of cool shade was great (and unexpected) bonus. We had all our meals there. It is a pity that all other neighboring units seemed abandoned. Casa di Rena seemed to be the only one which seemed to be cared of. There was a persisting smell in the bathroom coming probably from the dry siphons in the waste water pipes (we are not sure). The owner seemed to be aware of the problem because refreshing oil was plugged in. We hate to\he resulting perfume smell and have unplugged it. Then, the smell appeared and there was nothing we could do about it. We suspect that the problem might be related to the entire complex of which Casa di Rena is just a small part. Also, we have not expected such a long (almost 100 m) distance from the parking to the entrance to the apartment. At the age of 80+ it is quite serious problem when we had to move all our stuff.

This is the closest place to the beach! We had 2 rooms, one for us and one for our kids. Both were clean. The apartments are literally steps away from the beach and a great little coffee stand with amazing gelato. We were so happy.

Gianicolo Penny's Garden apartment was comfortable and well-appointed and suited us very well. The private garden that comes with the suite was a real plus. The apartment is well-located in a nice neighbourhood that offers grocery stores, pharmacies, wine shops and restaurants nearby. The bus into town stop right around the corner and we used this most of the time to get into and out of town. It's a walkable distance into town, but the buses are air-conditioned so we generally opted for that, since it was quite hot when we were there. Patrizia is very well organized, and provides a handbook with things to know about the apartment and the features of the neighbourhood, as well as restaurant recommendations. The bathroom has three different levels, so may not be suitable for people who are unsteady on their feet. Also a caution to tall people - the bathroom ceiling slopes and my 6'3" husband banged his head a couple of times, and the kitchen sink is set quite low. It wasn't a big deal for us, though and was outweighed by the plusses.
Nice location.

The VIEW!!! Staff is very attentive and helpful. Great clean rooms. Good spread of breakfast with baked delights and fruits.dinner was a traditional Italian 3 course set menu. Both were amazing. Parking - but the hotel advised it's tricky and paid street parking only. Be prepared to walk a bit and climb steps to get there. But if you have a seaview room, the view will be worth all that hassle. Don't lug big suitcases.. just a backpack of essentials will make it all worthwhile

From the moment of arriving, Antonio, Paolo, and Edgar were so welcoming. Not only is this hotel in the prime location of Florence; the rooms are absolutely stunning. Breakfast daily is a nice touch where you can eat in the privacy of your room or enjoy it on the communal terrace...the ham and cheese toast is the best in the city! The majority of sites, museums and attractions that Firenze has to offer are within walking distance. I did not like that I had to leave ... I wish I could have stayed another week!

We loved our stay at Hotel Silla. Location was superb, away from the busy town centre, but just a lovely 10 minute walk from everything. The hosts had some great recommendations for.local eateries and their breakfast service was brilliant. Our only wish was for a couple more days!

Amazing location in the national park, stunning surroundings. Very quite place where you will be only disturbed by the bird songs ! Very relaxing, we had to convince ourselves to leave to see the near by sights as it was so tranquil. It’s just an hour away from great beaches and the local hiking is also very beautiful. Wonderfully decorated units that are very comfortable and stylish. Bed was very comfortable and bedding was great. Original towels are a nice touch ! A family that operates this place are just spectacular! You get wonderful breakfast delivered to your door every morning, and they will help with anything you need, from restaurant reservation to home cooked meal. This place was a treat for us; we stayed at many other places but this one was highlight !

The breakfast was very nice and the attending staff was excellent. The only issue with the location is the only available parking is at the port...quite far with luggage, would be nice if the hotel would provide a shuttle.
Great location near the station. Clean facilities with a beautiful view.

The staff at foresteria were all so so accommodating and friendly when my motorbike broke down and I was stuck there. You really get the feeling that you're cared for, and the facilities are always clean and neat. I would choose to stay at Foresteria every time I'm in Giulianova.

Jennipher went above and beyond to make sure my son, who has a peanut allergy, had a special breakfast every morning. The location was great, and only a few minutes walk to the main action. The room was always cleaned very nicely and the staff were very helpful and friendly. The beds were very comfortable, and the AC worked great. Definitely recommend this property if you are visiting Sorrento.

Candid Review – 2.5/5 We were a family of four staying for just one night. I contacted the host on the same day the cancellation window expired, asking to cancel after realizing the hotel was kosher and quite far from the nearest canal stop. I explained our reason: 1 night with a family but they were unable to accommodate the request. To their credit, the host was friendly upon arrival and even met us near the first bridge to assist with our baggage — a thoughtful gesture we appreciated. While newly renovated, we arrived just three days after reopening. Unfortunately, there was still sawdust in the unit and especially noticeable upon waking up and on surfaces after placing items on the table. The A/C didn’t work properly — it kept running even after reaching the set temperature, making the room uncomfortably cold overnight. With only a thin sheet provided and no blankets or duvet, it made for a restless and cold night.. The reception closes at 8 PM so no one to contact but I did mention to the host at checkout. The bathroom was newly renovated and featured a doorless, tubless walk-in shower. However, the design caused the water to overflow across the bathroom floor after each use. It became slippery and unsafe to walk in afterward — a serious hazard, especially for children or older guests. Location: Located in the Jewish district, the area is very quiet and off the beaten path. It's a long walk from the canal stop, which is challenging with luggage or kids. Unless you're specifically looking for kosher accommodations, I wouldn’t recommend this hotel for a short or central stay in Venice. Overall: The hotel has potential, but with lingering construction dust, safety concerns, lack of comfort, and poor communication from the host, we left disappointed. Rating: 2.5 out of 5

i could not possibly recommend this hostel more !!! i stayed here for ~4 weeks/a month while doing a scuba course with diving sea club and i LOVED it here !!!! the host (salvo) and his wife are both incredible - they were always friendly, accomodating, ready to offer advice, and very kind, yet never overbearing at all. the location is perfect - it's less than a 1 minute walk from the fish market, which has awesome fresh fish if you're interested, but is also just a really cool experience regardless. it only takes 2 or 3 minutes to walk to the duomo, which is beautiful and surrounded by some really good restaurants/bars/etc (i'd recommend lettera 82 !!) salvo prepares the breakfast every morning, and the reviews saying that the breakfast is good are 300% correct - it varies a bit depending on the availability of fresh ingredients but generally included coffee/tea, homemade cakes (lemon, banana, etc), mini toasts with ricotta, butter, or the amazing apricot marmalade which salvo makes himself (!!!!! 1000/10; i normally hate marmalade, but i tried it one time then ate it every single morning), fresh vegetable dishes like cucumber with balsamic and tomatoes with fresh cheese, and some things like pasta with veg or this semolina (?) dish that looks like couscous with vegetables, which i wouldn't normally expect at breakfast, but which turned out to be a godsend for lasting energy for the day while diving the hostel is run by salvo & his awesome wife, plus reza who is a super chill guy and great to chat with, plus some volunteers who do a bit of (only very reasonable) work in exchange for staying at the hostel without charge, so all the staff is both very friendly/personable, and also just as excited about/interested in the city as the visitors are !!

Amazing place - 20 minutes walking distance to Coliseum, very clean, very quiet. The host was super quick with responses AND actions - once we had a problem with power (3 kWh overall load maximum we didn't know about) late in the evening, the host came 5-10 minutes later. Highly recommend. None.

The rooms are not well soundproofed, and guests in the adjacent room were very loud until 1 a.m. There are no restaurants within walking distance. The hotel tried to charge us €20 for a “late check-in” even though our arrival was self check-in. When we refused, they eventually dropped the demand. The host called us at 10:45 p.m. while we were trying to sleep to ask for our passports. The main door was also locked upon our arrival and no information was provided. There were, however, information on how to get in with the key and a useful video. Overall, the check-in process felt unprofessional and scammy. Personally, I would recommend staying in the city center near the train station instead, and taking the Alibus from there. There’s really no need to stay this close to the airport.

The main bathroom was large as were the 2 bedrooms. Lorenzo was super responsive to my emails ahead of time as well as my texts while we were there. Very nice people to deal with. Lovely location.

Apartment is well equipped with iron, kettle, mugs, soap, laundry machine. Bed is comfy. The AC kept going on and off at night and disturbed my sleep. There was something wrong with the kitchen sink, like it was constantly draining water even though the tap was off.

I really enjoyed my stay at this B&B. The location was perfect—so close to everything I needed, which made exploring the area so easy and convenient. It truly felt like the ideal home base for my trip. There was nothing I didn’t like about the B&B. Everything was just right and made my stay very comfortable.
Everything was superb!

Great location, walking steps from Termini . The room has all you need. Good restaurants nearby with multiple options. Lift (elevator) is quite small so we used the stairs instead, is on the 2nd floor so no big issue.

This villa was beyond our dreams. The bed was so comfortable, the room was beautiful but the best part were the staff:Luca was a host extraordinaire- he was a wealth of knowledge and recommended so many places to visit or eat. Merica was so lovely and made dinner reservations for us and Alessia was always so friendly. All 3 of these hosts were genuinely beautiful people who made us feel so welcome. If we come back to Italy I’d stay here for weeks! Nothing- everything was wonderful!
Staff was exceptional and breakfast was top notch Lousy stairs to get reception area. Minor complaint but staff was very accommodating with luggage so not a big issue.
Town was very nice
The whole set was great; The bedrooms were very tight had to use kitchen for suitcase
Perfect location. Easy communication. Great host. Very clean apartment. You will have everything you need.. All good.

We had a wonderful stay at Vallee Aurelia in Rome! The apartment was spotlessly clean, well air-conditioned, and perfectly located—just steps from the metro, which made getting around the city so easy. The service was exceptional. The woman who greeted us was incredibly kind and accommodating, allowing us to leave our luggage both before check-in and after check-out, which was a huge help. She also shared great local restaurant recommendations. We felt very welcome and comfortable throughout our stay. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Rome!
Good location Moldy smell. Didn' t look and feel clean
The location was perfect - very easy to walk to all the sights. Close to the train, good restaurants, and shopping. I didn't realise there would be shared "kitchen" space with three other rooms.

Our stay was excellent! Highly recommend. I stayed 4 nights, very comfortable beds, spacious quiet room, excellent breakfast and the restaurant is also very good if you don’t feel like going into town for dinner. The grounds are beautiful and well appointed. The staff catered to all our requests. The location is excellent, easy to find near the highway.
Very nice breakfast, friendly staff and free parking!

Really, it was exceptional. Raphaella wa so nice, welcoming and shared really helpfull information about the region. The Masseria is beautiful, our room was well equipped and large. Breakfast was excellent, much of everything you need. The pool was great after a long hot day of visits. I would go back anytime! Thank you! Nothing!

rooms very clean and spacious. breakfast was WONDERFUL, in the garden, with a beautiful view/peaceful. Option was to have it on your patio if you had a room on the ground floor. Pool area was relaxing and enjoyable. Drive to San Gimignano easy. Great to chat with host Roberto. He provided contacts for a private driver. Thanks for a memorable short stay! all good

Spent 1 night before our Mediterranean cruise. Alexander met us right on time and handled our luggage up the stairs. The unit was perfect. Very accomodating for early check in or late check out if available.. His restaurant suggestions were beyond excellent and we were absolutely dining like a local, off the beaten path. I truly felt like I was living in old Italy and pictured scenes from my favorite books. Step back in time with all the modern conveniences and Alexander by your side. Gave us directions to free shuttle bus to cruise terminal. Not suitable for mobility issue guests. Accomodation address was not clearly marked on Google Maps and was challenging to find.
Location was excellent and the modern, clean amenities made our stay very comfortable. The Parking lot is tiny and very difficult to maneuver with any size vehicle.
We liked everything...will stay again when flying out of Rome.. staffed so helpful..so clean...secure Nothing

Close to the path of God. Very helpful host. Thank you Amelia! Clean and everything to our liking AC worked well. We sleep with the AC on so the noise was not an issue, but be mindful there are roosters, donkeys and dogs around the property if you like to sleep with the window open.
Best location. Well maintained property. Very welcoming staff. Very good bar and food. Neat clean rooms. Nothing. Everything was perfect
Great Hotel and Staff!

Great location in Monterosso al Mare: 2 min walking from the train station and 5 min walking from the city center, and 2 min walking from the beach and restaurants. The room was nice, spacious, and faced by the water. Very clean and at night is very quiet. It was perfect. We will come back again!

We loved the staff so much. So friendly and helpful. would have liked a blanket on the bed. The air conditioning, location and the breakfast was nice too. The linens on the bed were starchy and stiff and we would have liked a blanket or duvet instead of just the sheet and a thin cover. And the rooms are very dark.

sizeable and great location, everything was very clean and it was easy to get around this part of the city. it was only 5 mins walk away from the Trastevere train station which made it very easy to get around. We would love to stay here again! It was a little hard to open the main door at times, which the host explained. However, our main issue was that there is little to no sound proofing on the sides of the unit and they were doing construction during the day next door so it was quite disruptive. We could also easily hear passersby but nobody was raucous so that was fine.

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment near the Pantheon with our family, including two teenagers. As a family of four, having two full bathrooms was a big plus. The teenagers slept on the pull-out sofa, which worked perfectly for us. Our flight was delayed, but the host was very accommodating and adjusted to meet us with the keys when we arrived. Evenings can be a bit noisy with a lot of walking street traffic but the windows did a great job of keeping most noise out. AC in the bedroom and main room means Rome's hot weather are not a problem. The location couldn’t be better, right in the heart of the old city and just steps from the Pantheon. We loved being able to walk everywhere, from ancient landmarks to charming piazzas and great shopping streets. Around the corner is the famous La Casa del Caffè Tazza d’Oro, where we grabbed excellent Italian coffee every morning. In the evening the piazza in front of the Pantheon comes alive with performers. There are plenty of restaurants and gelaterias nearby, which made dining out easy and fun. A perfect base for exploring Rome! Maybe a few extra pillows as there is only 1 per person if you are a family of 4.
Everything! Clean! Awesome location! Hosts were lovely and even helped us with our many luggage. Everything was perfect

Fair price, good location ( very close to the station and shops near station ), has breakfast ( not a really good one, but something ), fair service. Luckily we needed to stay 1 night there. Rooms really small, very dated and cleanliness is ok. The smoking smell in the corridor, luckily there was non in the room. Kid dropped small peace of food in the evening and in the morning there was a lot of ants over it. Rooms are ok to spend night, but I wouldn't wanted to spend there few days, especially if I need to spend time in the room.

Loved how close it was to downtown Tivoli ( 10 minutes walk) and the communication was amazing because we had to check in late. Breakfast was beautiful and the scenery was stunning Beds could have been softer
Everything! Absolutely beautiful place 😍

We were met at the property and given a tour and were able to ask questions and ask for local recommendations. Very warm welcome and helpful host. That we couldn’t stay longer! The property is exceptional and Salerno is beautiful.

The location and property itself were absolutely phenomenal. Outside of the Sorrento core, incredible place to take in the sights and enjoy the views below. The property was immaculate and the gardens were just the nicest place to relax.

The room is spacious and very clean the swimming pool is nice and there is a private parking. Take with you your own cottons no such amenities. The beach clubs in front reject people no accordance with the hotel it's not what you expect. Breakfast is limited someone is looking over your shoulder if you take something from the buffet and a deep pfff for the second coffee. At 10 you have to leave the room.
Great location, lovely hotel. The roof bar was really nice. Breakfast started after we had to leave and there wasn't a take away option at all
The staff were all exceptional and accommodating. The pool was lovely! The breakfast delicious :)

It was quiet in the accommodation, though there was sporadic noise from the street. A better arrangement for collecting the key might be considered; the pizza man's social graces left something to be desired.
The setting, nature, the surrounding villages, the peace and quiet, the garden Nothing. We had a wedding to attend in Braccio and the location of the villa was perfect for this.
The pool was awesome! Friendly staff, great location. Close enough to walk to the central part of city in a few minutes.
This was a very pleasant room in a very quiet area. The location was a short distance from the main tourist attractions. We found the bed a bit uncomfortable.
Beautiful place, very good location.

Other than the challenging stairs getting up to the apartment the location was good. It was an easy walk from the building to everything we were interested in. I found the stairs up to the apartment very challenging.

I super surprised by this hotel. I needed it for a short one night stay by the station to work and it honestly exceeded my expectations. My room (single bed with private bathroom) was really spacious, everything was super modern and clean, they provided quite a few amenities, and the staff was really nice. I have nothing wrong to say!
Wonderful apartment! Clean and spacious. The breakfast was excellent. The air conditioner is powerful in this very hot weather. I highly recommend the stay. Nothing
The 3 bedrooms with their own bathrooms was a plus. Elevator not functional and bathroom showers need upgrading.

I have to say that Palazzo Dei Fiori was one of the best parts of our trip. After a long and tiring day in the city, it was so comforting to know that there’s a safe and amazing place waiting for us for the night. The kitchen space was much appreciated too, as we made our breakfast ourselves every morning. The closest supermarket was only about 7min walk. In fact, everything was very close by, yet the location of the hotel was extremely quiet:) Big thanks to all the staff and especially Valentina! You all made everything so easy for us❤️. I would definitely choose this place if I ever had the opportunity in the future. As per our messaging: “Not up than 30 Years old 🤣🤣” (inside joke lol) Nothing- everything was amazing!

Great room, centrally located and affordable rates to be so close to the Sassi. Helpful staff in guiding through the ZTL and where to find convenient parking. Breakfast the cafe down the street was great!
Clean, A/C working properly, easy check-in

Very close to station San Pietro and St. Peters Bascilica. The checkin process was bad. Wrong codes vere provided. The apartment is not a deluxe apartment. The living room is the balcony. The place was still being cleaned 30 minutes before the checkin. It does not have a microwave. No paper roll provided in the kitchen and only one waste basket. Th guests are supposed to dispose the garbage with no instruction provided. The value is only the proximity

Anima Franca was an absolute gem of a B&B from start to finish. Our hosts were super friendly and very helpful. The place is newly renovated, bright, cool, and squeaky clean. The breakfast was simple but delicious (fresh baked bread and croissants, meats, cheeses, fruit, yogurt, good coffee, and a variety of tea), and although it was served from 8 to 10AM, when we mentioned we were starting out early, the hosts were more than happy to accommodate us. There were also a lot of little touches such as extra pillows, a dispenser in the kitchen where we could fill our water bottles with natural or mineral water, a small fridge where we could buy cold beer or Prosecco on an 'honour system', just to mention a few. Our room was quite spacious (unusual for Italy), and the blackout blinds worked REALLY well for both light and noise! (We had a few roosters next door that we thought we might hear in the mornings, but it turned out the room was so quiet we couldn't hear anything at all! Complete silence!) Our queen-sized bed was also the most comfortable we had out of the three hotels we stayed at while in Italy. They also have an immaculately kept pool out back, which was sooooo necessary, as we were there during the heat wave in July. And the air-conditioning worked really well! We could not say the same of the other hotels. We enjoyed it here so much that we ended up cancelling our last night in Florence and staying here an extra night. Thank you, Hélène and Pierluigi! We will definitely be back on our next stay in Greve! The only thing I would recommend would be to add a few umbrellas by the pool.

Great location if you are interested in visiting Ostia Antica, which is literally just steps away, or similar sites outside of Rome. Highly recommended. The only thing I didn't like was the smell of the air freshener in the apartment, which smelled like creme caramel, but that is highly individual; perhaps others would really like this scent.

The location was very good. The rooms were clean and comfortable and the daily room cleaning / towel and coffee service was very much appreciated. The hosts were helpful and knowledgeable. No negatives at all.
Great inviting host

Our host, Signore Roberto was very nice and accommodating, very knowledgeable and a good historian. The place was beautiful and well kept with pride of ownership. Thoughtful upgrades like sound blocking windows etc.we even got a bottle of Prosecco and voucher for breakfast treat! It's a bit tight in hallways, bathroom and sitting room which is common with heritage buildings, and may not be suitable for little children so they don't fall or break something valuable.
Within 750 of Mercato Centrale / Leather Market with parking (albeit expensive). A/C was not working well during my stay.
Great location to everything we wanted to see. The bed was terrible. Unfortunately bed is a big requirement while booking a room.

Lovely little apartment close to the airport. Grocery stores and restaurants just down the street. We enjoyed spending time on the balcony taking in the breeze, and then also coming inside to the air conditioning! We will be back if we are ever in the area again.

The location is great, the hosts are friendly and helpful, except for the beds, everything in the apartment worked as advertised. There some street noise from parties in the weekends which is fine with us as it is a city center. The mattresses in both rooms were in terrible condition, and we couldn't get a comfortable sleep or much sleep at all. Having a comfortable bed is the most basic need in any hotel or apartment one stays in. There are two bedrooms and the condition of the mattresses in both beds is screaming for replacement.

The property was in the perfect location, walking distance to most major sites. Weronika was a fabulous host, she frequently followed up with us to ensure we were comfortable and if we had any questions and required any supplies. We are definitely coming back and highly recommend this property to anyone interested in visiting Rome.

The view was spectacular. The apartment and property were very clean. It felt like a small resort with the pools and bar. We had the market, bar/gelateria, and pharmacy within walking distance. We also had spiaggia della Marinella walking distanc, which was stunning. The sunset from our balcony was amazing. The shower was really small.

The room was clean The breakfast was excellent and complete The location is easy to access by public transport. However, I booked a suite with two extra sofa beds instead of a regular room, and I already paid for that; they charged me for my two little kids. It was very surprising and unacceptable. That extra money was so expensive and changed the price at the end. Also, the garage is not easy to access.

Do not recommend!! Wasn't able to check in despite giving plenty of notice when we were going to arrive which was within check in hours. Nobody answered WhatsApp, email or the door. Ended up having to book somewhere else.

We loved everything. The host was incredible, and she became like family. We love you Rita, we will definitely be back to see you ❤️ rooms were incredibly spacious, clean and fully accommodated. Location was fabulous and so pretty 😍 The air conditioning situation was a little sensitive for some......but of everything that was one of the only challenges.
Great staff. Fantastic beautiful place. Highly recommend

Location is about a 10min walk from the S Giovanni train station, and very accessible to the promenade and Old Town. Reception & access instructions were very easy to understand and worked seamlessly. Carolina, the manager, was also very receptive, engaging and helpful.

The room is near different public transportation (bus, tram and metro), Maria who welcomed us was very nice, there was air conditioning in the room and a balcony and there is a Conad (small market) in the same building. The neighborhood is questionable (many homeless people, even near the entrance door at night), the small fridge took a whole day to become cold, the shower takes time to drain, the TV cable didn't always work, some of the pillows were uneven and had to be reformed during the night.
Staff were super nice If the wifi could be good everywhere , and in the rooms, that could be a perfect stay
Very nice included breakfast. Convenient parking. Friendly staff. A little out of town, but can walk to restaurants and shops.
The staff were lovely. Very kind and very accommodating.as we had 3 bikes.
Excellent spot in Lake Como. We stayed earlier in Bellano and wish we had booked here first. Our children loved the pool, and the views were spectacular
Very well maintained and clean. Modern facility and has air conditioning! They had breakfast, and the lady was an excellent host all around.

They so kindly with as i appreciate the staff in reception they upgraded as to junior suite it was wow really the bad very comfortable I will came again and again the bast hotel in Milano No things but I hope make breakfast make more bigger
Owner was very kind Gave us a ride to the airport early 15 euro A bit hard to find

Location. Stone throw from the beach and train station. Short walk to the restaurants in monterosso al mare. The breakfast served at the sister property (located right in front) was incredible. Eggs, bacon, yogurt, pastries, fresh fruit, great espresso, fresh squeezed juice, tomatoes, cheeses, cold cuts, etc. Had everything and a great staff. The room was tidy everyday. The AC unit worked great and kept the room cold even as the weather outside over 95. The balcony was great to sit out and have water views. Very clean location. Nothing for me. The room is up some stairs so that might be an issue for some. It is a smaller room. Suited best for a couple or single.
We loved our home away from home! Great apartment and great location just up from the beach. Enjoyed that it wasn't on the busy side of town. Little grocery store just downstairs was very convenient.

Super clean, amazing location, great and friendly hosts. Felt welcome and safe throughout our stay. You will have breakfast in your room. We were three and it was crowded, would have preferred more space for breakfast. Also breakfast was ok but not what we expected (limited choices).
Clean rooms and incredible staff. They could not do enough to help us out. Nothing

Lovely staff, from the manager to everyone they were soo pleasant, helpful and friendly. Clean rooms, incredible breakfast!!! I would definitely stay there again and recommend Albergo Diffuso Mannois for your stay in Orosei! Loved its quaintness!

The outdoor space was exceptional. Plenty of loungers and seating available. The property offered ample privacy and was located close to Alberobello and neighbouring towns. The inside space was a little small for more than a couple but the outdoor space made up for it.
Nice place and nice people

Very clean, comfortable and bright. Great breakfast. Friendly and helpful staff. Best shower we had in Italy so far! Location is also great for walking to nearby site seeing, shopping and restaurants. Perfect place to stay in Messina!

The pool is the highlight of this property. Beautiful olive trees, sauge and rosemary everywhere… Breakfast was excellent! Homemade lemon cake, tarts, fruits and coffee. Elixir from Giuseppe was a nice healthy touch. We even brought the ritual back home ;-) The owners are thinking about a more spiritual concept to come, so that’s to keep in mind if that is not what you are looking for. Though we enjoyed staying there with our children; being with the owners’ family and pets onsite was a memorable experience. Very generous, thoughtful people. Hard beds, but we still slept well… thanks to our busy days exploring the area ;)
We loved our accommodation at Golf Bogliaco…stunning place and wow what a view! Drive is a bit tricky for North Americans but that’s Italy! You get used to it very quickly.
Loved the location and the space. It was very comfortable and the hosts were amazing. There were 4 flights of stairs that we didn't know about.

Namy was super helpful and so pleasant. She greeted us every morning with a good breakfast and gave us advice on where to eat a traditional Bolognese meal and of course Gelato. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the property at all. Wonderful location too.
Valentina made sure we were comfortable and well taken care of. The location is perfect. A bit difficult at first to find because the streets are closed off.
Central location in the city, apartment very well equipped beyond expectations, and very good communication with the owner Nothing, everything was good!
Excellent location. Breakfast was good.

Location was great for us. Our host was available anytime of day and very nice. It was sparkling clean and newly decorated. There was only one garbage can in the place, none in the bathrooms. Otherwise, it had everything we needed.

breakfast is very basic nothin fantastic. we stay at this hotel when we go to rome its nice , clean room , staff is friendly, the roof top bar is a plus overlooking piazza navona. highly recommended breakfast could be better

The location was absolutely superb. 15 feet from the stairs to the subway and the Cadorna train station (best way to the airport) was across the street. The Duoma was about a 15 minute walk from the apartment. Having a washer/dryer in the apartment was a great convenience. There were no instructions available for how to operate the washer, TV remote, stove, etc. It would have been very helpful to have had a little booklet for these things in English. Mostly very clean, but the floor over in the corner where you hang your clothes was very dirty. Hopefully they will speak to the cleaners about that.

I liked it all. The photos dose not give it justice. In Realty it is more. Loved the space, layout, furniture and the jacuzzi is extra star ( though didn't have the chance to use it. The building is spotless clean. The washing machine was in the ground level and you have to pay extra for it. Though it was will accessible , organized and clean.
Uncomfortable stairs. Place and area not very secure.
Breakfast and multi lingual tv channels
Everything great. Beautiful space. Raw Nature around. Would reccomend for sure. Rooms are not super isolated (soundwise) but still - super good experience!

Hotel was very clean, hotel smelled nice, located in the port of Naples. Room was cleaned daily. Elevator access. Room was spacious. Views of the cruise ships in the port. Super quiet and staff was available at lobby front desk 24/7. Bistro was available during certain hours located just a couple steps from hotel main doors

The apartment is quite nice and the room is good, too. Also, two sets of towels were provided. The owners are nice. In such hot weather in Napoli, there was no air conditioning available in the room, only a small fan on the wall which didn’t work. I couldn’t sleep at all on the first night. My whole body was sweating when I lay on the bed. I felt a little suffocated. But I felt better when the owner gave me one more strong, powerful stand-by fan, but it was still hot in the room. When I asked the owners why not install air conditioning, they told me that it is a historical building and it is protected. However, when I went out the main gate of the building, I looked up and found many air conditioners on their balconies.

If you’re looking for the perfect Tuscan Villa, Podere Bellavista is truly the vibe. From the moment we arrived we felt welcomed and very taken care of. I cannot say enough good things about the staff. They are all incredibly respectful, kind and caring. Gabriel, the head server is knowledgeable, funny and personable. Virginia went above and beyond to help us get our baby monitor working to ensure we could keep an eye on our little one while enjoying a few date nights on the property. We highly recommend having dinner at the restaurant each night. We tried 3 different set menus and can’t choose a favourite - they were all incredible. We were told the chef has 50 years of culinary experience and has worked in Micheline restaurants. Without a doubt some of the best food we’ve ever had travelling. We rearranged our travel itinerary to do a cooking class after leaving Bellavista as we did not want to leave the property. We planned our trip around the availability of Podere Bellavista, and we would absolutely do it again. Bellavista and the surrounding property is so picturesque and stunning. If you ever get the chance to visit the Sam Gimignano region, Bellavista is a must stay place!
breakfast is at different location nearby

The swimming pool area looks modern and spacious with a great view. The restaurant is a beautiful structure. The room was very clean. Breakfast was satisfactory. Cooked eggs available at an extra charge of 6 euros per oder. The staff were cordial enough, but other than a daily text to ask if we want a dinner reservation, there is no inquiry about guest satisfaction with their stay, even at check out. The room was NOT LIKE THE PICTURE OF THE DELUXE ROOM on booking.com! There were no balcony doors with a Juliette balcony, only a small window, so the room was very dark. After inquiring, the receptionist said I should have specifically requested a balcony! When I showed her the picture on my reservation confirmation from booking.com, showing a room with a balcony, she said there are only balconies in the suites. I was later shown, by the other staff person, a room along a dark corridor and up over black stone steps with no rail, to a room that looked more like the picture on booking.com, but as it was up another flight of stairs on which it was hard to see your footing, I was concerned about falling. We kept our assigned room. Once settled in, I wanted to try the pool. I was looking forward to this, as it is advertised as a heated swimming pool. It was absolutely FREEZING! Definitely NOT AS ADVERTISED! The restaurant is beautiful, and the restaurant staff were nice and professional, but the food is overly fussy, and the portions are VERY small, while the prices are higher than similar high-end establishments. We, therefore, only ate there one night. Having chosen this place over others in the area, largely for the advertised heated pool, room pictures, and restaurant availability, we were rather disappointed. If those things aren't as important to other people, they may enjoy Firriato more than we did.

Excellent location. Basic room but very clean and perfect for a short stay in Rome. The host is very cooperative. Easy to walk to most places from here. Would definitely recommend. The bathroom is a little small. But totally manageable.
Great staff, modern clean aesthetic would book again
Very cosy and pleasant atmosphere. Great location, beautiful design, comfortable rooms and bedding, tasty food, welcoming and attentive staff. Feels like home!
Beach and Hotel garden

Room was very spacious and comfortable. A nice view of the rolling hills from the outdoor sitting area. We didn't have breakfast, but did have the coffee, and it wasn't very good. Didn't feel like this was a 4 star hotel and the value for the money wasn't there. It was a pleasant stay, just felt it was over priced. Wasn't much to do there. We better experiences in other places in Tuscany.
The total stay was a wonderful experience, the view from our room was amazing, breakfast was excellent. The location super good.

We had an unforgettable time during our stay in Sorrento! The location couldn't be better – right in the heart of everything, yet peaceful and relaxing. Waking up to the breathtaking views every morning was like a dream. What truly made our stay exceptional was our amazing host – warm, welcoming, and always ready with helpful recommendations to make our trip extra special. The property was spotless, beautifully maintained, and had everything we needed for a comfortable and relaxing vacation. We truly didn’t want to leave and are already dreaming of coming back. Highly, highly recommend – this is the place to stay in Sorrento!
Friendly staff AC worked all day and night and still the temperature in the room didn't go bellow 29C

very clean, great breakfast t, very friendly staff, The information about how to access the parking was a little confusing, there are 2 gates, you need to go to the 1st gate to be able to access the 2nd gate, we waited for a long time to talk to someone

Breakfast was fabulous… many choices, lovely are to eat in, lots of fresh fruit I really think there should have been a comfy chair in our main area. A High top table and chairs were the only places to sit if you weren’t on the bed in the loft. There was room for one soft chair in the area… so would have appreciated that.
Beutiful,renovated unit. The owner is very supportive and nice. Shower is the best. Washer and Dryer in the unit. Not a great area to walk around.
The location was good. It was close to all amenities, restaurants and shopping Parking was limited and expensive.
Incredible!! Stunning property, spacious, clean and comfortable. A short walk to the city centre and a short drive to the beautiful beach!

Spacious apartment. Location was very central. It was a bit of a walk uphill to the center (3-5 minutes) but that's expected considering the town is on a hill. The view was amazing. 2 small balcony, one in the bedroom and one in the kitchen with a view of the sea. Kitchen was nice. Well equipped Coffee Machine was too difficult to use and leaked. Coffee it made didnt taste good. Something very minor and wasn't a big deal but if I have to write something bad that's it
Pool was amazing! Breakfast had great selection and was very good! Location of the hotel was perfect. Close to Noto but out of the busyness. Was very relaxing and quiet.

Location was excellent as it was a five minute walk to the Termini Main Train, metro and bus station. So it was easy to get around. Excellent for late arrivals as staff is there til midnight. There were many restaurants open late for dinners. With good cafés for breakfasts. The coffee in the lounge could be better.

Awesome beach - very relaxing and 3 min walk from the apartment. Good location of the apartment - it was easy to do day trips from it. Instructions for the key access were very accurate and easy to follow. Host was very helpful with exrta information
Lots of room for our family! AC was good. Location was excellent. Hosts were readily available. Wifi was very slow, and not always working. Light blankets on the beds would be nice.
The room size is very good and the air conditioning is excellent. The bathroom needs updating and the stairs to get to the apartment are quite steep and narrow.
Super clean and close to everything. Host was amazing and super helpful with everything and recommendations. Noise travels a little bit so can be slightly noisey at night.

Friendly and informative host Beautiful location with a fabulous view from the breakfast terrace. The shower in the bathroom was almost impossible to use as it is simply a small round bar attached to the middle of the wall with a shower curtain. Water was cold and did not come to temperature. Nice rooms but somewhat damp and musty.
Great location, modern, clean, and very comfortable. Staff was super nice and helpful. Will come back if in Milan again. Gym is small and somewhat limited, had no towels.
Everything! It had beautiful views gardens. Great location. Comfortable room with all amenities.

It was very conveniently located. There was a bit of a la gauge barrier challenge, initially, but we overcame it. Great value. As I mentioned, we had a little trouble communicating but it was short lived.
Great location, very nice room and bath, awesome breakfast, and wonderful hosts. It was great staying there.

We loved everything about this place. From the easy check-in procedure to the ergonomically excellent layout, this was great. Zero issues, just a great experience. There was a loud humming noise from about 6am on the last day. We think it may have been another resident's washing machine or more probably a drier.
Excellent location, amazing views. The host was very responsive and helped us find parking. We appreciated the snacks and espresso machine. Thanks for a great stay!
Good location, helpfull staff, close to plenty of shops and restaurants, 5 min walk from Caraia bridge. Old and charming building.
Room was clean and comfortable. Host contacted us beforehand for check-in. Location is close to metro. Elevator was coin operated but we weren't given the key to use it for free.

This location, among the 11 stops made all over Italy and other parts of Europe, sits at the top of our list B&Bs. Much of this has to do with the host alone, Rosie. She is a true reflection of Sardinian hospitality. The location excellent, and this town is one where one could consider living for months on end. Rosie's home is clean and in prestine condition. The housekeeping, breakfast, accommodations in general were 5 star. . 10 score on booking. Will revisit. Thank you for the wonderful stay.

Hard to find something but it is well located to take the train/bus It is like staying at a hostel but paying the price of a hotel. The furniture was very old and dirty. If they want to keep it as is they should cut the price by 70%. Also the receptionist said 3 words to me: name, ID, upstairs.

It was a great location. Front-desk staff were very nice and competent. Parking is NOT included on the property! It says it is but you have to park a 17 min walk away and pay over 30 euro a night. They also said they would have a gluten-free breakfast (we let them know weeks in advance) and they only had a few crackers. Nothing else was offered.

The lounge was very beautiful, and I enjoyed the nightly events hosted at this hostel for the travellers. The air-con in my room didn't work during the day (only at night), so it made resting during my siesta a bit uncomfortable. The beds were nice but a bit cramped, and there was no good place (ex. nightstand) to put one's phone while sleeping during the night.
We had a great stay here. The house is managed by a lovely lady who welcomed us and served us an amazing Italian breakfast. I would recommend this place to all travelers.

Location was in middle of historic city. All attractions were steps away and yet it was very quiet as the property is located on a narrow side street too narrow for cars. The owner was on site every morning and very helpful to make sure we had a great stay
Very comfortable clean large room with comfy beds.
The size of the apartment was perfect for our family of 6

Location was great. Walking distance to down town. Central to Catania and Taormina. Breakfast was fantastic, loved the prosciutto, orange juice, & home made cake. Easy entry to rooms/garage. Had lots of fun in the pool. The staff is so sweet, helpful and friendly. A little softer beds and a door sign for cleaning/do not disturb.

The staff was wonderful!!! One of them even gave our son a giant tin of Pokemon cards after noticing our son’s collection, it made his whole experience memorable, he is still talking about it! Also the Aperol Spritz and the gin tonic are delicious!! Even though the hotel is on the boardwalk in a busy spot, the rooms are quiet!
They were kind to let us store our bags after check-out so we could go sightseeing before flying home.

Great location, old hotel with lots of major attractions close by. Rooms were pretty authentic Italian with comfy beds and pillows. You know when the pillows are so thick your neck hurts and you can't get comfortable. Not these, there were soft and flatter which I personally love so that's awesome. Nice suite with a tub which was nice to soak in after a month of walking around Italy in hot weather. Restaurant view was great however only a sliver of the colleseum... But lots of other interesting stuff to look at. American bar on rooftop was nice for a very expensive cocktail but hey, when in Rome 🇮🇹🤗 Hotel front desk greeters are just not that friendly or welcoming but whatever. I'd be annoyed with tourists too, however we ARE the reason they have that job. A simple smile would be awesome.
Ac didn’t work, breakfast was only one slices bread and cheese in the room. Wifi didn’t work
Our experience at MòN was very good. The staff was very helpful. The breakfast service was very efficient and the food was excellent. And the restaurant pizza is as good as advertised.
Close to the beach They charge you for towels to go to the pool. Never see that in other hotels and also you have to give a warranty. The rooms are very small

The unit was great, it was clean and fully stocked, including lots of toilet paper, which other rentals lacked. This unit was large enough for my family of 5. It also included enough coffee for the 4 mornings we spent in Verona. Very little................it there was anything, we had some ants in the unit, likely from a food spillage from the previous renters, however, Dimore was great, I advised them and they paid us a visit to spray some ant kill......great service.

Room and suite was clean and modern and great location. Wish the whole building was as well kept. Difficult to communicate to get our key and the entrance to the building had some construction done and it had a musty, dusty scent in the staircase until you reached your unit. Should have made made more of a point to have this spic and span as tourist dress up to go out for the day the evening. Not up to par.
Relaxed atmosphere. Good location good food Excellent service Needs a better spa.

the location was great! we were walking distance to both town and beach! The hosts Domenico and Anna were so kind and made us feel right at home. We drink a lot of coffee and they were sure to bring us more without question. They also provided a list of restaurant and beaches to visit. The room was also super clean when we arrived. It was also very convenient to have free, private parking on property. We also really enjoyed having our dinners outside on the patio area. It was a very calm, tranquil and quiet area. Would definitely recommend! The only thing that didn't work the best for me was the wifi. I had to work from the room, which includes having video calls for a few hours per day. The wifi was good enough for basic needs but if you are planning to do work (especially video calls) it could be an issue. Otherwise, for basic leisurely internet searching, I'm sure it would be enough.

Very friendly hosts, and helpful. The place was clean and quiet. Beautiful balcony outside where you can sit down and enjoy a nice cappuccino and have an overlooking on the area where you are staying. Many restaurants nearby at walking distance, and the food is excellent, you can eat like the locals. They are hard to reach if you are using the booking.com chat. The easiest way to get in contact with someone is through WhatsApp, but they have to contact you first. You have to budget a little more than what you paid for the hotel. I didn't know we had to pay Italian taxes in extra. That is an extra 3 euros per person, per night. Breakfast, if not included in your package, is an extra 8 euros per person per day. And shuttle to the ship is an extra 10 euros par person. We were a group of 4, so we needed 2 rooms, but they said there was a glitch in their system that made them to overbooked the place. So, 1 couple had to be transferred to a nearby hotel that was substandard, and they weren't very happy with their stay.

We truly valued the location close to everything walking distance from La piazza. Valerio and his staff were absolutely amazing. Ready to assist in all excursions where we needed help. We would strongly recommend any travellers to book at this location. We will definitely book again!
Everything about this place is perfect! The staff is super friendly and helpful. Second time staying there, and we can't wait to come back. We didn't like that we had to leave.

We arrived the hotel around 12:30pm and our next appointment was 2 hours away. The front desk staff kindly let us check in early and the room was really clean, spacious, the bonus is the room has a balcony! The hotel is close to the Terminal and so convenient to go by subway, bus or train.We are very happy to choose Best Western as our Rome hotel and highly recommended.

The room was nice and newly done. Not enough covers for 3 people and 3 one should be bed and not cot (it should be stated in booking) for the value of the money. Also, if dining needs to be booked in advance and not find out at dinner time that it was full. Pillows were a little to flat for my comfort, so it would be nice to have an extras available. I did not request it, so it is my fault too.
Rooms are clean, spacious. It is well located. Pasquale is very kind. I though it was closer to the beach, it is a 15-20 minutes walk, beach are not public you have to reserve in advance.

Easily the most unique and beautiful hotel i have ever been to. The property is charming, enclosed and breathtaking. Each room is unique and comfortable. I genuinely enjoyed the nightly turn-down service. The front desk staff, a lady whos name i did not get was extremely warm and accommodating as well as the bar staff. If I am ever in Sorrento again, I would stay no where else except Relais Villa Savarese. I was here with my two young children.
Very friendly and a lovely room. Thanks for the cookies mama!
The staff was very helpful, they called taxis for us and very nice and friendly. The room was spacious and comfy. The hotel was very close to shops, restaurants and places to visit.

Absolutely beautiful property, lush with beautiful plants, and a dreamy pool. Mauro was a fantastic host, kind and amazing with his communication. Breakfast was perfect to start your day. Can't wait to come back!

After the chaos of Rome, we loved the privacy and beauty of the garden and terrace. Our host was a great help in arranging drivers from the train station and to the airport at the end of our stay. Our room and bathroom were very comfortable.

The apartment is spacious, with 2 bedrooms and has everything you need for a nice stay. The location is perfect, walkable, close to restaurants and attractions. There's a free municipal parking lot close by. The apartment is in the second floor with stairs, be aware if you have mobility issues. The air conditioner is on the leaving room and the bedrooms can get a bit warn in the summer.
I did not include breakfast in our room. The view from our room wasn’t great.
Perfect location
Everything was perfect – the best choice for anyone looking for a quiet place with air conditioning to stay during the hot Tropea summer. All good

Our stay at Ale & Andry House exceeded all expectations. From the moment we arrived, Salvatore and his wife were incredibly kind and attentive. They found us a free parking spot, personally drove us there and back, and allowed us to check in early. Communication was excellent throughout our stay — they responded promptly via WhatsApp and provided us with great recommendations for both Cefalù and Palermo. We had 10% discounts at various restaurants near the apartment. As a generous welcome gesture, they even offered us a delicious bottle of wine. The apartment itself was spotless, very quiet, and very comfortable. It was fully equipped with everything we needed, including a well-stocked kitchen, a washing machine, and beach essentials like towels, chairs, and a parasol. The location was ideal — just a 4-minute walk from the beach and steps away from restaurants and shops. All of this came at a very reasonable price. We wholeheartedly recommend Ale & Andry House. It was a true highlight of our trip. Grazie mille!
great hosts, very informative outgoing and fun some rooms were downstairs and it was hard with the luggage
The staff (Igor) was very nice and helpful. We got free upgrade so our rooms be adjacent. Location is excellent and close to everything you want to go especially the train station.

Hotel agreed to change rooms for us (to a view room) without charge. Front desk staff were very helpful. Breakfasts were OK but nothing special. The breakfast room was very tight and the tables made it tough to sit without knocking things over. The biggest issue was the very narrow and steep access lane to the hotel. This made taking the bus as suggested by the hotel to access Florence only possible by using taxis. So that was a $30 euro hit each way. And getting taxis to return to the hotel at night was not easy.

We had such a great time at the guest house, it was so clean and the perfect room and location for us. they were so welcoming and the breakfast was delicious set out in the mornings! it was an amazing trip

Luxurious, modern and spacious chalet in a breathtaking setting that feels like being transported to ancient Italy and away from all the hustle-and-bustle! The combination of pure relaxation with beautiful hikes right from the front door provides for a perfect getaway! Communication and advice on the area from the host was excellent throughout. Absolutely worth it!
great location and very helpfull staff cant think of anything

Excellent placement, close to the train station, close to the center. Looks good and modern, very comfortable and perfect for a couple. Owner was very accommodating to flexible check-in. There was a slight sewage smell lingering when we came back from our walk, but it went away when we opened the window for a bit and it never came back.
Staff and accommodations were fantastic. Conversano is a nice, friendly little town, not far from the usual touristic Puglian destinations. It's great to use as a base.

This Bed and Breakfast is a little slice of Sicily. Beautiful gardens, charming decor, and the authenticity and warmth of the hosts truly make it special. The breakfast offers a variety of sweet and savoury options, and the room was spotless and very comfortable. Giovanna was kind, attentive, and quick to respond to any questions I had. I truly hope to return for a longer stay!
location & security I only stayed for 1 night
Both televisions didn't work as advertise. And the parking was not free as indicated. Only after you confirm your stay, they tell you that you dont meet the criteria and have to pay 50 euro to park.

The owners were very nice and did their best. The location was extremely problematic. The buses did not show up several times near central station leaving us in an unsafe situation several times, one time we took a taxi and because it is out of the city, they charge double. The location is not functional for most travellers using it as a base. The breakfast consisted of 10 cakes and pastry, which did not taste very good; and we don't eat sugar for breakfast at home. The owner was very proud of the breakfast, but for us it did not work out. I can't let my son eat chocolate cake for breakfast. As well, they insisted on keeping the main doors unlocked, upstairs and downstairs and the lock was missing screws upon arrival, clearly people had tried to break in. They still wanted to keep our section unlocked. I found the security an issue.
Great rooms, clean and spacious. Kind of difficult to find. The number 14 was not visible clearly.

Let's start with the welcome that made us feel like they couldn't wait to meet us. We dined almost every night at the hotel. They have a menu plan which is a 5 course. They grow most of their vegetables. This hotel staff are very accommodating and considerate. We would stay here again. We have been very fortunate to meet wonderful people here. Not a thing. It was clean, and comfortable, a great size room and balcony, wonderful food, and extremely relaxing.

This place is absolutely stunning Perfectly located in Puglia to visit the different towns. 7 minute drive to the beach. The house is impeccable and clean. Central air conditioning to keep you cool on those hot days! Modern and convenient location and the host is super responsive and friendly. Stop looking, this is the accommodation you need if staying in Puglia. Already working on our next stay for next year. Thank you for making our vacation hassle free and contributing to our happiness! GRAZIE There is nothing not to like
We like the location, in a quiet residential area,and near the tram. The place is so homey and very clean. The owner is very nice and gave us a lot of tips and information.
The location was great, the room met all our needs and the decor was 10+ Great service from the hosts as well. Would definitely recommend a stay here 👌

Very clean, linear not cluttered airy with a good view. Location was a bit hard to find. Google maps doesn't tell you how narrow (very narrow streets) are.. But all summed up it wasn't bad.... Not a complaint. Just a heads up.

The 2 guesthouses were very welcoming and pay attention to all your comfort. The meals were excellent with very good quality. Their wines are divine ! It is a great place to rent for family or friend events. Beautiful panorama. I will come back for sure ! Silvia Canadese 💜💜💜
This host is among the best you will ever find. She is amazing in every aspect and makes me realize I need to improve as a host myself. Nothing.

Amazing location for hiking, very clean, wonderful pool/ rooftop area, and great customer service. The only thing I would suggest is a fan or AC for better air flow, it was a bit warm in the room evening and to fall asleep.

The location was good. Bottles of water were always available. The building entrance and our room had a0 horrible stench. The room was far too small for two people. There were 5 steps to descend for the bathroom, which was dangerous at night. Aside from directions on how to enter the first day and how much to leave in tourist taxes, there was no follow up from the contact person.
Everything was walkable, place had some character. Many restaurants and shops close by.
The apartment and deck is wonderful.Large room.,great decor and dood washroom facilities The temperature of the room could have been higher.It was not adjustiblep 2
Comfortable spacious room. Very quiet at night. Great location to do day trips.

Good breakfast. 5 minute walk to train station. Clean. Friendly lady in the breakfast room. Bed's a bit soft. No lift. A little difficult to find as the house numbers go up around the corner of the building. The hotel is behind the veterinary clinic.
everything was pretty good .staf very friendly. breakfast very good staying too short
Great location, very accomodating and responsive host!
Exzellent breakfest, good location to go downtown with nearby shopping mall if you forgot something to pack. Happy to use their underground parking since it was rather hot. Really nothing

Where to begin........ We traveled as a family of five for a wedding in Brisighella. We can never express enough how wonderful this experience was for all of us during our stay at La Melagrana. When we arrived we were greeted by the loveliest couple, Jurgen and Anke. Despite arriving later than we anticipated, we were received with the warmest welcome. Jürgen and Anke's attention to detail in every respect far surpassed our expectations. The accommodations were pristine and extremely well equipped for our comfort. Our breakfast each morning was prepared with thoughtfulness and served with a variety of sweet and savoury. The views were beyond incredible. The grounds were meticulously maintained, and the use of the pool was the cherry on the cake. Our stay at La Melagrana was no less than magical, very much like a fairy tale right out of a movie. Without a doubt, this has been one of our favorite travel accommodations ever! We will definitely be returning to La Melagrana. Everything was perfect.
the place is very well organized clean in a great location we were welcomed and very helpful

We had a great stay at Hotel Flora - the location is great, within very short walking distance shops/restaurants in Frascati. The staff were friendly and helpful; parking was free and easy; breakfast was plentiful. The room was bright, clean, and spacious and the bed was extremely comfortable. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again!
I liked absolutely nothing. Everything which they said was a lie. This is a fraud company. Everything which they said was a lie. This is a fraud company.

The room decor was unreal, so unique with lots of special touches, created through creative vision and love! The bed was the biggest and comfiest we slept in throughout our 2 week trip through Sicily. Vito was incredibly helpful when my girlfriend left her ear buds in the room and had them mailed to us in the UK. Thanks Vito!

Krizia was an amazing concierge. Service from the staff was exceptional. We enjoyed the food at the poolside bar as well. It's a great location and space for families. It's farther away from Taormina city centre and Giardini Naxos than I expected, but it was easy enough with a rental car to get around.. I wish the mattresses were more comfortable!

Not easy to get in without a working Italian phone. I was lucky to meet a stranger at the station who spent an hour helping me to get to the apartment and to get the codes from the owner. The apartment was dark all the time because the heavy metal blinds on the outside did not work so no daylight or fresh air for me for 5 days. Very basic and very small kitchenette with a fridge impossible to get to without hurting your hands. So, overall, it was OK but not a comfortable stay.
Cosy apartment Distance we carry luggage, No elevator

The place was well within walking distance in the places we planned to visit. We had a nice view and the Owner was very accommodating and understanding as we were late in check in due to an unexpected train strike

The location was amazing! The hotel was very unique (a bit hard to find in the beginning) and had a cool layout. The breakfast was great. Staff were very helpful and kind. The price was quite high but given the location I understand why. Many sites within walking distance
One of the most comfortable sleeps we have had. Very very comfortable bed! Room is excellent. I would stay again

Facility was extremely clean. Daily house keeping service was a pleasant surprise. Staffs were friendly and helpful. Breakfast was Good, different types of eggs could be made upon request. Close to port, in the center of leisure area. Had a little farewell present. We will be back for sure!! Nothing

Bathroom clean and spacious, good water pressure. There's a fridge in the room. Check-in instruction was very clear and easy to follow. Smooth and timely communication. It would be helpful if there's a rack or something like that in the shower space to put shampoo bottles.
We were here for 1 night and the location was perfect Many options to eat and shop. The coliseum was a 15-20 walk.

Good price. Location was not central (too expensive for us) but very close to metro, bus and shops/restaurants. There was enough beds for us and kitchen was useful. The guy who welcome you is welcoming and patient. Air conditioning works well and equipement is not new but functional. Could be cleaner. Big bed is too hard for me.
Overall it's a beautiful apartment, spacious and clean. I suggest to add a toaster to the kitchen... It would make having breakfast easier.
The breakfast was lovely, lots of items to choose from. It is also in a great location close to Termini station, which is what I wanted on arrival from Lecce and to get to the airport.
There were noises from inside and outside the building at early hours.

The three-bed room had a really nice view of the church across the building. It also stayed lovely and cool on the rather hot day we were there (thick walls do help), and was easy to air. Nice & quiet too, with just friendly chatter of passers-by on the street (with open windows).

The location was great and Antonella who received us was helpful and super friendly. Check in by appointment was frustrating. I didn't realize how strict they were on check in. I am an avid traveller and every place I have stayed in gave you a window to check in. This place pushed for an exact time which really hampered our vacation as we had to change plans to ensure we were there for the appointed time. It would have also been helpful if instructions were provided on parking (others warn you on a tight space). Parking was very challenging given the size of our car - so much so that we dinged the car trying to park. We only needed parking for the first day but were told that if we wanted parking we had to pay 10 euro each day of our stay regardless of not having a car after day one. Also we had no garbage bins in the room - we had to throw everything outside of our room which was a pain.
some dated , property needs a refresh
Lovely Hotel, friendly helpful staff Restaurant service limited to breakfast

If you want a real authentic taste of Italy then this B&B is a perfect choice. Olga was very attentive always respecting our privacy. Very quiet and comfortable. The breakfast was so perfect. It was close enough to walk to most of the places we wanted to go. Communication was easy.

The grounds and the view are beautiful! Having a pool is nice, and it's only 15 minutes away from Pienza by car, which is a really nice city to go in for the day or for dinner. We booked a family suite, which came with the smallest fridge we ever saw. They provided no wine glasses in the room for us to enjoy some wine (we are in Tuscany expecting to be able to enjoy the bottles we buy at the vineyards we visit) and no bottle opener. The family suite is one room with a bed and one room with a sofa bed, for 220 Euros a night is just not good enough for the price. Everywhere else we stayed in Italy, we got way more for this price. We were quite shocked on arrival. We tried enjoying our stay as much as possible and not be brought down by what felt like a bad hotel choice, but we can't even say we liked the food because they charge the same price as restaurants in town. There is no benefit for guests to eat there. Aperol Spritz for 10 euros doesn't make sense when you're paying 220 euros a night. This is also not as pretty in person as on the photos, things are older than they look on here. I feel bad leaving this bad review, but I really feel like we relied on ourselves to have a fun time, and the property more often than not felt like we had been duped. The lounge chairs are mostly broken, the umbrellas are sometimes too small to provide shade for more than half a chair. We went to the pool one day and couldn't really find comfort there. I know this may sound harsh, but when you pay a certain price, you expect certain services. We came for a relaxing vacation in Tuscany, booked for 5 nights and wished we could have left after one. I will not remember this place very fondly, and they are sitting on such a beautiful property that could be soooo wonderful if they just decided not to cut corners.
Unique Nothing 0
Bad smell and dirty area

The rooms were spacious and a great respite from the heat. The breakfast had many options. The staff were extremely nice and helpful, even sent us a list of recommended restaurants. The hotel pool was stunning and was maintained very well. The only downside I'd say was the coverlets on the beds - they were not clean.
Property had ants and smelled foul. Person greeting us requested 32eu and did not explain why
The quiet, clean and comfortable bed. The location a bit far from center but quiet at least
LOCATION. LADY IN THE KITCHEN was very nice. she offered to bring the breakfast tray to the outdoor terrace as there were steps involved. LOCATION
Location was great and the breakfast was awesome! Valet parking was also very helpful and they have a lovely rooftop bar.

Good location away from the tourists by a couple streets. It was quiet and easy to walk to from CA D'or valporetto.. Breakfast was good with lots of options to choose from. Room was extremely small and tight. Sink in bathroom took up entire space so nowhere to put your toiletries and makeup while getting ready. There was a leak on the floor by the bathroom onto the carpet. This was reported to the hotel to fix for future guest. Air conditioning was around the corner from the bed and did not get much airflow making it stuffy.
Close to the staion which was perfect for us. No coffee available although it stated there would be tea and coffee.

The apartment was very comfortable and full of everything that you need for a longer stay.. kitchen and appliances excellent, bathroom too very roomy, sleeping rooms very good,bad and matraces too.The area around the appartment is nice and very good conected to the Padova center..In total we were so satisfied. Thank you.

Very clean and comfortable hotel, friendly staff and great location. Parking was easy as there were spots on the street if the main parking lot was full. Bus to the castle and old town was within walking distance. Our kids especially enjoyed the breakfast buffet and the pool. Our safe didn't work that well, and it wasn't able to be fixed during our stay

Nice little bed and breakfast and owner Antonio was helpful with accommodating us with 2 cribs. Place was well kept and nice setting in front of the beach! Includes free coffee and water and snacks. Overall a nice experience here and great if you're staying for a night or 2 It's a very small room for a family of 4 and would probably not go back for this reason. If the rooms we're bigger, then it would be worth it because it's a clean place. There's a shared kitchen, but owner was firm on not using stove unless for heating food for kids. If you're looking for a shared kitchen, then be aware that the owner is not a fan of having you cook or heat food. It's a tiny kitchen also so not much space! Probably not the best B&B of you're staying more than 1 or 2 nights as it's a small location and limited space

Very spacious room and bathroom and very comfortable and quiet, despite being above their restaurant Small fridge in room was nice for our early breakfast Nice terrace behind building from restaurant which we could use Location was ok. An easy bike ride to the center but it would have been a long walk. Free parking beside building ok but very limited so a bit chaotic with cars of other guests Welcome and infos was sparse but ok - The owners run the ground-floor restaurant so that was their main focus. The bike parking was just on the gated restaurant terrace behind building so not quite as secure as we would have liked. Neighbourhood ok but looked a little run down
Beautiful room well located in venice No early check in
Great place to stay, super friendly and helpful hostess, wonderful breakfast and the homemade apple juice was amazing. Secure bike parking. Right on cycling path. Not a lot of restaurants close by.

Located at 10 minutes walking distance from the Pompeii Ruins, the bus stop for Mount Vesuvius and the train station. There was a great all-you-can-eat sushi bar and a passable café nearby (about a 5 min walk). There's a solarium but it's rather more like a terrace which is quite vast. The AC was quite good. There were ants in the room. The sink was clogged up when we got there. It was very hard to get a hold of the owner. The water temperature in the shower had two sets either Arctic cold or hot Inferno. We wanted to store our luggage in the reception room but the owner wasn't ready to accommodate us even though we provided a time to pick back up our luggage because whenever he leaves (which is for most the day) the reception room is inaccessible.

Very nice updated hotel, very clean with friendly staff and good breakfast. Only complaint is the elevator is old and can be temperamental. Stayed here to visit Pompeii, Sorrento, and the Amalfi coast over a few days and worked out great!
Great location. Very clean. We had to pay 10 euros per day for parking.

Lovely place with lovely staff. Great room and surroundings. The owner recommended a restaurant close by that was very nice. The AC was quite loud. For us it was not a big problem as we could open the window but it could be something to improve
A more comfy bed would have been nice.
Great location! Wonderful coffee shops and grocery stores near by. Short city scooter rides to all the main attractions.
The place to stay when visiting Florence. I will most certainly stay there again on my next visit. Nothing.

We LOVED Il Salotto di Maria Pia! The rooms were nicely furnished and very quiet. The bathroom was modern and superb, loved the shower. The BEST part was that our room had a little balcony overlooking the Piazza Duomo (and I mean it was RIGHT on the piazza looking towards the cathedral that was built on the site of an Ancient Greek temple with columns still visible!) and there was a superb cafe for breakfast just outside the door. So the location was SUPERB. There is no traffic on the piazza either. Ortigia is very chill and quiet (definitely the best area to stay in Syracuse), and it was wonderful watching people wander by beneath our balcony. Our host Paola was very sweet and tried very hard to make sure everything was going well for us. She was very easy to stay in touch with via WhatsApp. Even though she was dealing with some family issues, she made sure to check in with us throughout our stay and made sure our room was tidied while we were out. Overall a great place to stay. Note this is not a hotel-type stay, but rooms in a building. Can't think of anything important. One note: I think it is important to make sure you let Paolo know your arrival time so she will be there to meet you.
beautiful house, very comfortable stay
Thank you so much Veronica, for your warm hospitality. Your home was the perfect place for our family.

It was the most beautiful property, with amazing views and very comfortable. We adored all the thoughtful and artistic decorations and especially loved the outdoor kitchen and incredible patio. The property felt enormous and luxurious for 4 adults and could have comfortably held 6. The owner was perfection and helped us whenever we needed it and went above and beyond in service to get some forgotten property returned to us. I couldn't recommend more highly.
