The location was perfect. We flew to Treviso Airport and took the airport bus to the Treviso train station. Then it was only a two minute walk to the hotel. The next morning we went back to the train station and took a 30 minute train ride to Venice station. The cost of the hotel was definitely less than staying in Venice. The hotel itself was quite nice although there were renos going on so at times it was noisy. The room was nice but very small. It was difficult to walk around the bed.

The apartment is close to some of the main attractions The service was terrible. The AC is broken and the owner was aware of this judging by reviews that were posted days before our stay. If those reviews would have been posted sooner I wouldn't have booked. Too much clutter in the apartment, it looks like an episode of hoarders and they don't dust. The blinds were broken which was also mentioned in previous posts and when I messaged the owner they didn't seem to care and acted as if it was the first time they were hearing this. Owner also asked me to cancel my booking and rebook with them at a lower rate. I am happy I didn't as I can see it would have been worse service then through booking.

It was clean, the kitchen had almost what you needed , close to the center, close to the market and grocery stores. Easy to get into the apartment and to get from Porta Nova by Metro. First, it was very impersonal, nobody came to greet us, the communication was done by messages. I prefer direct contact. Very noisy starting at 6:30 AM, the apartment has the windows in the courtyard and the garbage bins are removed every morning with a lot of noise. After that the restaurant staff came and emptied the glass bottles into the garbage bins, at noon time, a lot of noise, also renovation to some apartments, a lot of noise the entire day. It lasts till 10:00 PM. We got only one set of towels for five days. We asked for two more detergent pods, so we could wash the towels but we were refused. The apartment was clean and spacious, dark because the windows were frosted and looked towards the courtyard, no direct light. The city is very nice 👍 lots of things to see and lots of good restaurants, close to the Garibaldi street.
Room with a view on the canal.

Location was perfect, on the main strip and close to the beach Noisy strip at night & host was not on site when we arrived and was not responsive to our email confirming our arrival. We had to wait approx 15min outside our apartment building to access. Would also have appreciated wine glasses and opener, maybe some water bottles in the mini fridge? There was a private bathroom, but it is not in the room. It is accessible via a shared hall. Been traveling Sicily a lot and its those small little gestures that are memorable from hosts

We loved staying here, the peacefulness, nature and beautifully restored house. It was very comfortable and the hosts were lovely, very thoughtful and kind. It was a special time for us and we fell in love with Isola di Elba.

It has Air Conditioning! That alone made me give it a high rating because Rome in the summer can get hot. However, it is a beautiful home with lots of nice art and furniture; you can tell that effort was put into putting the home together. Hot water in the showers, nice mirrors and TVs, a full kitchen and a fridge. Not too much I didn't like except for the fact that there was nowhere to do laundry and I can't recall if there was an iron or not (sorry if there was, I just forgot). Also, I did find it expensive relative to other places in Europe. However, I think Rome in general is just an expensive place.
Staff attentive and helpful. Breakfast a 10. Rooms cheerful clean and right in beach !!

Location was good. 10-15 minute walk from Center Breakfast was good Not soundproof room. We were in second floor and were bothered but people walking above us on third floor. If that bothers you, make sure you get the third floor Pillows were so flat and uncomfortable
Perfect location, kind and very generous hosts! Great apartment!

Apartment was nice and clean and nicely decorated, AC in every room is a bonus, 2 bathrooms are great, and lots of room inside and there is a grocery store across the street. Access to room with 20 stairs to climb with large suitcases, not enough towels, no oven, no water pressure, no kettle, no toaster. breakfast was just a few wrapped bread products
Clean, friendly staff. Nice pool. Very good breakfast. Had to drive to reach town, castle, etc.

Nice, comfortable sports hotel with friendly reception Room fairly small but nice small balcony towards the mountains and large bathroom Very good, secure bike storage facilities Breakfast buffet was quite good (but strangely for a sport hotel didn't have müsli among cereal selection) Location ok but a bit outside and above town so not a quick stroll into town Nearby "Pit Stop" Bar full of motorcyclists playing loud music until 2am (probably not every night but worth checking) We ate at restaurant which was nice enough but as cyclists we would have preferred simpler, less-expensive options Overall we felt it was too expensive for what we got and ate
It was a newly finished room with a bathroom, for a good price. Very clean, and close to the airport. No wifi. The room was away from the main building and no wifi was available.

We just stayed one day and it was very convenient for us. Location is just across Roma Termini Train station, so it's very convenient if you are either coming from the airport with the Leonardo Express train or another city by train. Metro station also at Termini station, so easy to go anywhere. Lots of restaurants, supermarkets and cafes around. About 20min walk from the main shopping areas. Room was spacious and comfortable. Bathroom was also large with bathtub and a separate shower box. Bed was good and wifi worked well. We stayed for just one day and nothing called my attention negatively. We didn't try breakfast since we had an early morning flight out of Rome.
Very good breakfast I stayed there to be close to the ocean, beach was great however I had a hard time with public transportation

It was my first time in Stresa. A beautiful place. . It was unfortunate that there were many mosquitos. Another thing was the hotel. Although the building is magnificent, maintenance was so bad. One of our rooms A/C was not working. Upon several calls, maintenance staff showed up and informed us that this suits A/C had a problem even before our arrival. It was a strange thing that this suit was alloted to us despite the fact it had a maintenance issue. I believe hotel management could have done better. Those two reasons made our vacation in Stresa to be below expectations.

I liked the layout of the hotel, all rooms were seperate. I liked the location, highly convenient, next to the beach and not far from the airport. I liked the morning breakfast, good choice and the food was yummy. Staff was really helpful and kind. The hotel itself is also secure and I liked that they had a parking lot to secure your car in. I also liked that despite being beside the airport, we didn't really hear the planes once we were in our room. The beds were not very comfortable but thats europe for you. Also the wifi kept going in and out because of the airport being nearby but there was nothing to be done about it.
Everything. It was amazing, great location, great view, great staff.

Great host - our questions were patiently and promptly answered and requests accommodated. Excellent location - 5 minute walk to the congress centre, 10 minute walks to 2 different subway stations, a bus stop near the building. About a one hour walk to the city centre. Good choice of restaurants nearby. A supermarket nearby. Everything was very good.

The kitchen was available free of charge. I was able to make my own meals with fresh vegetables and pasta free to use. Lots of seating areas to eat, read, play games as a group. It's a very comfortable feeling here.
It's a nice, cozy place. Many thanks to Paula for the great accommodation and for making sure everything was going well.

Staff very friendly and helpful, room was clean and spacious, breakfast was decent if you are looking for a bit of everything. Great low key area, close to.metro line and just next to funicular that takes you in.les than10.minutes directly to the lower parts of the city where all the action is if that is what you fancy. Its not really an issue but the towel change happens every 2 days but i asked for an new one sonce mine was still wet and the conscierge gave me an other one with a smile and zero fuss. Again very friendly and helpful.
It was a great experience Professional Staff
Close to bus stop, restaurants, shopping. Room security was good, friendly owner. AC could be cooler
Great spot!
Location was perfect Helpful staff Breakfast was basic but plentiful Smelled like they had just sprayed(bugs)

Seamless online check-in with clear guidance. Room was well-equipped with high-quality amenities, bedding, and a warm welcome with snack boxes. The manager went above and beyond when my car broke down in the parking, she handled everything with exceptional care. Truly outstanding service. Highly recommended. Nothing.
Location! Cleanness, large rooms, kitchen equipment and quick response from the host
beautiful room

I can't even imagine what else could be done in this apartment for a perfect stay! Everything has been thought out down to the smallest detail! One of our most luxurious and comfortable stay! Every day was a dilemma to go somewhere or relax on the balcony with wonderful view! Communication was quick and efficient and late check out really appreciated. Thank you! That we stayed here for only a few days
Very particular location
I like the place so quite and near to bus station and train station. Near to everything

The apartment is well located and very comfortable. Natasha was very helpful in giving suggestions as to what to see and where to eat. The 50 stairs to climb from the apartment to the street although they are considering an elevator option.
The owners were beyond warm and so very helpful. Excellent service!
We like the location,in the middle of restaurants and shops. Near all the boat station and tourist attractions.
Breakfast was really nice. Staff were really very helpful and pleasing. Good value for the price paid. Will definitely recommend it to others to stay. Our shower are was really small, but we managed.
Beautiful property - feels authentic but is newly built with modern conveniences. Very clean. Staff was very friendly and available. Pool doesn't have a view, however feels nice and private.

My mom and myself had the pleasure of staying 8 nights at B&B Leonida in May 2025. Rosy, Giovy and their parents are exceptional hosts, both in their customer service, their personality, their genuine care and curiosity. They helped organize activities for us (boat excursion & agrotourism). It was so nice to get to know them. They’re present hosts but not intrusive. A Perfect balance! The rooms are kept very clean. The breakfast / lunch are so tasty and abundant!And the coffee 👌🏼 B&B Leonida is located outside of the hustle, it’s nice to get away to a quieter area. We personally liked to walk to and from town. We’ll cherish the memories spent at B&B Leonida.
The location and the breakfast.
Elevator! Responsiveness. Location!

The location was not too far from the main square. The breakfast Antoinetta made was amazing. It was always freshly made. The place was always clean. Francessca and Antoinetta were very helpful with any challenges or questions we had with regards to transport or sightseeing recommendations.
The best Location on the Resort you can imagine. Directly on the beach. You need to pay attention to the GYM. Check the equipment and the conditioner there.
Great location, very clean and staff are great!! Nothing
Recommend getting a more usable coffee machine.
Superb, friendly and helpful host.

The staff at this location are very kind and helpful. They offer a little continental breakfast, plus water bottles and pastries in the room which was very nice. It was very clean and comfortable with air conditioning. It's very close to the airport and they offer and very reasonably priced shuttle to the airport (20euros for up to 4 people).
It is very clean room and affordable. Airport shuttle from/to airport is available 24 hrs and affordable compared to taxi and Uber.

See below I would not recommend this property to anyone. The location is extremely isolated and far from any major attractions or amenities. We booked this hotel based on the photos and description, hoping for a relaxing stay with a beautiful beach nearby. Unfortunately, the reality was far from what was advertised, and our experience was frustrating from the moment we arrived. Upon check-in, we were given a verbal list of all the things we were not allowed to do, which immediately set a negative tone. While the room was clean and the bathroom tiles were attractive, the shower was a small, inexpensive corner unit—surprisingly basic for a hotel that markets itself as a “spa.” The room itself was very small, with no seating area apart from the bed, and there was nowhere on the property to sit and relax unless you were dining at the restaurant’s patio. We were also told we could not drink in our room because previous guests had caused damage. Instead, we were provided with two paper Dixie cups—an odd and unwelcoming gesture. Many of the rules in place felt excessive and unreasonable. The "beach club," which was a major factor in our decision to stay here, turned out to be a gravel beach—completely misrepresented in the photos. Additionally, the hotel is not beachfront at all; it is located across a busy road, with constant traffic noise from both the front and rear of the property. Throughout our stay, we encountered multiple issues. One particularly troubling incident was when staff entered our room despite a "Do Not Disturb" sign on the door. We were later told we had to notify the front desk directly if we didn't want anyone to enter—something we’ve never experienced at any other hotel. Staff also asked intrusive questions about our comings and goings, making the atmosphere feel uncomfortable.We were there for a week! (The woman who made breakfast in the morning was lovely. Kind and very helpful-I felt she was embarrassed by how we were treated).

The location was perfect. Our balcony looked down a short street and we had a view of the ocean. My husband and I wished we had one more day there to just relax on the clean beach. Thank you B&B Was nothing not to like. It was cozy.

The location was close enough to the main attractions, but also peaceful and quiet. The staff were amazing, very warm, helpful and caring. The breakfast was very good - diverse and fresh. The balcony in the room view was amazing over the lake and across to the mountains on the other side of the lake.
Everything! Nothing!
Everything! Location, food, cleanliness, very helpfu, comfortable bed,l and friendly staff. Good breakfast buffet included! I liked everything.
Location Super old. Air conditioning didn’t work. They put us in an old apartment room, instead of the two rooms we had booked

the location of the hotel is convenient as it is not too far from the water taxi stop. there is coffee and a fridge in the room, which is convenient. we had the first floor room, which was less convenient as you couldn't really open the window and the room is a bit dark. the pillows can definitely be improved.

Started well with a host who was easy to communicate with and accommodating. The Location was absolutely amZing allowing for an easy 7 mins walk to everything. Property was quaint and spacious as well. Also loved the old exposed beams throughout the house The only negative was that it was clean but not spotless. Maybe the cleaner missed it but it did not deter for an otherwise great stay.

Far from the city and very isolated from the main city Breakfast was just ok. Not much vegetarian options available. We asked for the iron and board and after sometime we personally go and bring it to our room.
Lovely owner -so helpful Very far from "everything" - it's way up a hill - follow her directions NOT Google Maps (which will frustrate you as the Google map road is wicked switchbacks
Breakfast was simple and adequate Staff weee lovely Fresh coffees excellent Rooms were a bit smaller than I would like

The location is good about 10 min walk to the city centre. The building is old but renovated. My room and the bathroom were clean. The bed was comfy and the wi-fi was very good. The breakfast was also good served in the garden. The staff friendly and helpful. I had a comfortable stay and recommend the hotel for solo and young travellers.
Beautiful property in good location. There was four of us travelling and this penthouse provided us with plenty of space.

We liked everything the rooms the reception the welcome very nice also the breakfast they drive you to the beach club also in good alignment with the hotel. Cannot think of anything I did not like and I am always quiet critical but nope perfect place.

The location was close to transit or an easy 20 minute walk to the main train station at Roma Termini. Another 15-20 minute walk to Trevi fountain. Easy to get around on foot and staff more than accommodating in calling a taxi if needed. Very good breakfast. I think it's a European cultural aspect, but we could never find facecloths in any of the hotels. The smallest they provided were hand towels which are too big for washing your face in the morning or evening. Interesting to adapt to.

Fantastic stay! Great location! The place was comfortable , clean , awesome air conditioning which we really appreciated with the recent heat wave. This apartment has everything you need , kitchen well equiped, elevator, lots of hangers and drawers , very comfortable sitting area. Lots of plugs throughout, nice and bright. Beautiful private balcony. The host wad also extremely responsive answering us right away. I would highly recomnend this apartment you wont be disappointed. I would stay here again without hesitation. Nothing

The moment we arrived we were welcomed by Rita. She is super nice and speaks also very well German. She showed us around and made us feel welcomed. The rooms were clean and cozy with southern charm. The white shutter doors lead out onto your own veranda with a sun umbrella and lounge chairs. The bathroom is spacious and clean. A highlight was also the breakfast buffet, excellent. The hotel is easy to find. We left the car parked the whole time and walked everywhere. 5 min from the nice beach and just a short 10 min walk and your in the middle of Cannobio with the market and all the restaurants . If you have time stroll though the charming town. We will definitely be back. Thank you to Rita and the staff. We appreciate your hospitality.

The dinners were fabulous. Joanna did an incredible job with preparing delicious dinners. I would come back just for that. After traveling for a month in Europe and eating at different restaurants , Joanna's meals were by far the most delicious!!! Joanna listened to what we wanted, and she delivered. Thanks so much. We were also glad Joanna and Halina spoke Polish. It was a bit scary driving on the narrow, winding roads, but the views were incredible. Fresh air, beautiful views, nature at its best!!! I hope we can visit this place again.

The breakfast was amazing and the spa. The facility and rooms are clean but kind of outdated. Family not as described on the site. Smaller and not comfortable. Quiet area and safe. The internet was horrible, horrible, horrible. Not working at all. Only working at the lobby. The A/c was barely working. Room not as described. Smaller and having sofa be ( uncomfortable) instead of a queen bed

The food was good and good value. The lobby is nice The beds were very old and torn underneath. Nothing was provided like towels or blankets. Only pillow and sheets. People had a party until 2am outside in the back of the hostel. I didn’t sleep well at all.
Close to attractionc Breakfast, no elevator, a/c not working well

The apartment was extremely clean and comfortable! The breakfast and beverages provided were such an unexpected bonus! We even had our family who lives close by come to see the property and they are now recommending all of their visiting friends and family stay here as well! We will definitely rebook when we come back!

I was very thankful when I was able to check in a bit earlier - and spent the afternoon resting in this quiet home during the heat of the day. It was a pleasant room with very clean and European fixtures. I was content here. The location is out of the way and not easy to find. I was given a maps link to follow but it didn’t really work and I arrived at the wrong location! Thankfully a young man on a scooter drove and I followed him to the real location which happens to be across the street from the high school and on the road out towards Bova. There was no breakfast at this B&B.

We had to change our hotel last minute while we were already in Rome and the staff was very helpful and understanding of our situation. The room was very comfortable and spacious and the location was perfect for walking around the city but also for coming back to our room during peak sun hours to avoid the heat.

Breakfast was excellent however air conditioning or fans would be appreciated in the dining area. Too stuffy. Overall the staff in ever department was wonderful. Our bedroom was too small. Location is far from historic center and too far from train station.
Great location near Trevi Fountain and easy to walk to other sites. Room was clean and air conditioned. Antonio was great and also helped with transfers from airport and to port.

Perfectly situated in the piazza, steps from the restaurants and cafés. The staff really care about your comfort. When you arrive, you'll get a short tutorial to ensure you understand the entrance codes. Ignore Google maps: you can't drive up to the property, since it's in the piazza. You'll have to find public parking nearby through Pizzo's narrow, winding streets—this is more of an indictment of Pizzo than the property. The room we stayed in was pretty tiny. You'll notice that old building smell, but it passes quickly.
Extremely nice room. Very clean. The host provided a lot of useful information on what to do and where to eat. Would definitely go back! A little out of town, but can use subway easily.

Welcoming staff, perfect location, and very nice beach. Wonderful garden, very quiet and relaxing place overall. Excellent for families, also with young children. We ate at the restaurants every day and the food was good 80% of the times. Somewhat heavy to digest. Next time I'd consider the apartment solutions at the camping side (baia degli aranci).
Came in by bus left by train. Perfect location for both and super.close to sights

We took this place for the view and I’d does have a great view. Everything in the room is old (1970s style) but it is clean and has been taken care of. The breakfast was great. There is noise and smell from the boats in front. The TV is unusable (small, old and far from the bed).
Great room for a short stay. Comfortable and clean. The location is ideal, minutes from the local shops, restaurants and the sea. I recommend this place for anyone passing through Porto Venere.
Great locations. Clean and peaceful. Very helpful and friendly hosts Difficult to find but worth the effort. Car is a must.

The room is close to the Scavi di Pompeii, also there is a grocery right around the corner and great restaurants nearby. The room has all you need, even a kettle and the coffee machine in the corridor. A lot of mosquitoes and street noise. It was hard to fall asleep. Everything else was just great! Thank you for this lovely location.
Close to Fiumicino and the pool The outdated decor, the twin mattresses instead of a king, the breakfast, our fridge wasn't working and they didn't fix it

Close to airport. Staff are nice, friendly, knowledgeable. Staff called a cab, the service they use for guests, a cab driver canceled before the pick up in the early morning. It was a rush to find another transportation to the airport; I almost missed a flight.

The location and the facilities and the upkeep of the gardens. It is a beautiful property. Beds were very comfortable! Also, the pool and deck area were great. The rooms and curtains were a bit dark, and the sofas were not very comfortable.
Had everything we needed. Great location with so many restaurants to choose from.

This is our second time to Venice. Though it was located on the outskirts, it is close to the water taxi and is in a quiet part, with some great restaurants nearby. Three bedrooms with three bathrooms was great. The best part may have been the host. Very communicative and helpful. I wouldn't even look for a different place next time. No real negatives, with the only challenge being on the third floor, having heavy baggage could be tough.

The location was great for sure. It was in the middle or close to everything that you would want to see. Shopping was outside your door or a 15 min walk away for the gold bridge.. The plumbing was suspect with the shower and washing machine. You will have to turn the shower off multiple times while showering, or it will overflow into the bathroom. The washing machine has a drainage issue as well. We had to ring the clothes out by hand in order to finish the cycle. I msgd the property to let them know. However, complaints go back a year or so, and nothing has changed in regards to drainage. Location is impeccable, so the drainage issue isn't a big deal for us.

Good location close to lots of restaurants. Had snacks. Gentleman who helped us at the venue was nice, but person who communicated via WhatsApp was quite rude. Also you only get a sheet and there are no other blankets on the room so we were very cold at night.
Hotel was great! Good location, fun area, beautiful place! Rooms were very comfortable!
There's water dispenser which really helps especially in the summer. Location is close to attractions. Nothing

Close to train station, so convenient. The rooms were clean and at a fair price. A little courtyard which is also used by the restaurant is at the back. Check in was not easy. I arrived a bit late due to train delays. I did info the owner of the delay. The owner had left and had not forwarded instructions as to how to enter. Eventually another customer who arrived when I was suppose let me in the main doors and instructions with the key to the room were found. Instructions on the outside were to go next door to the restaurant which was closed. The other customer had a similar experience of no one there upon arrival, although she was emailed a code to the outside door and instructions as to how to find her room and key. So please ensure you get a code and instructions in the event that this were to happen. I was an hour to hour and half in the heat outside the building before I was able to enter my room. You must be able to climb stairs with luggage. Windows are covered with wooden slates which do not open. Air conditioning was not in the room when I arrived, but once I turned it on it worked well.
Magical accommodation in a magical place. Kids loved living in a luxurious cave.
Room was quiet and isolated from traffic noise. The morning breakfast was crude where all the guests sat at a picnic style table. Privacy to enjoy breakfast was very limited.
Everything was perfect! Amazing place to stay

Its a fully furnished apartment, good for short and long stays. The staff were great, Marco was very helpful. Note that you need to buy or get along washing machine and dishwasher pods if you are planning to use them. Also recycling garbage bags for a stay over 2 nights. The staff did communicate ahead of 1 day from our arrival for check in details. The reception is at -1 but easily accessible by stairs and elevator and the brass gate is obvious from the street. Cleaning is for extra charge. Location very close to train station. It would have been great if recycling garbage bags are provided during the stay as it didnt make sense to buy them for a short stay. Slight maintenance is required. The property can add more details of the amenities included or not included on their website or OTAs. The aircon system was hard to control.

The room was large and the balcony was a nice touch. Pool was absolutely beautiful. The first bad sign was the bathroom. Specifically, the toilet was not cleaned when we checked in. The property is located a bit further away than expected, with nothing around to walk to. I was a bit concerned with the safety of the surrounding area. Unfortunately, on two occasions, we were scammed by the taxis here. I reported the first incident to the hotel ( as it was quite scary ), and they assured me they would assist with my next taxi ride, but when the time came... the hotel did not. We also were scammed on that taxi. We checked out 2 days early. And did not receive any compensation for the pre paid rooms. I will never pre pay gor rooms through a booking.com site again. I tried to book the shuttle as that seemed safer to me, but it was never available. When I tried to book it for the airport they said it's too expensive and just booked a taxi. Well, the taxi cost me more. The driver pulled his..."it's Saturday scam, and charged us 20 extra euro. Room service at this property is terrible. Even the pizza is sub-par. I ordered the rs chicken and it was old and overcooked. When I asked for a fresh one, they basically told me that's how it's served. Ha! Im a culinary instructor, so they tried to bs the wrong guest. Breakfast buffet was not bad. Rooms are very dark, but having a balcony was nice. My son and I were both covered in bites the next morning. We were not outside at all during the evening, so I'm not sure what bug this could have been.
Clean ,organized,good food The elevator,one elevator and the wait

We were so pleased with our accomodations! From the seamless check in process, to recommendations for restaurants and the convenience of the close proximity to the central station, cafes, restaurants and meeting points for tours, this was absolutely the most perfect location for our family trip to Milan! The accommodations were as described and portrayed in the photos. It was clean, esthetically appealing, and more than enough space for our family of four.
Perfect location for layover. very close to airport.

the hotel is very pretty. The terrace off of our room was a lovely bonus. The black out shutters were great. The room was small but appointed as expected. the bed was hard. I prefer one mattress and not two adjoined, the pillows were uncomfortable and need to be changed out.
It was perfect! Fantastic location

The view from the hotel is amazing and its a very romantic place to stay. However getting there can be tricky without a car. Its about 10 mins away from the main town. The staff was very nice. Breakfast was great with lots of good options. We had dinner there both nights & it was very tasty, but a bit overpriced.

The house is located in a great location. It has lots of space and the balconies are great to sit on. The host is quick to respond. The master bedroom bed is very uncomfortable. I ended up sleeping on the couch instead. There was no wiggle room for a late checkout even though I looked on line and it wasn’t rented for the next night and mid communication about what level the flat was on. We had messaged to see if it was on ground floor and was told yes but it was actually up a floor. This was asked due to health reasons and needing a ground floor due to not being able to climb stairs.
Good customer service. Clean bedroom, bathroom, free breakfast. Proximity to restaurants, groceries.
Breakfast and lunch, great air cinditioning; Not clean washroom

Loved the location in the center of the old historic area. It was partly an ancient cave dwelling. Lorenzo was kind enough to pick us up from the bus station and his father dropped us off when we left. It was advertised as a 2 bedroom so we were expecting to each have our own room, but only one bed was prepared. The shower is tiny so would be difficult to use if you're a big person.
Comfortable, great for two nights. Excellent AC, room was cool at night. Close to everything. TV had streaming services! Could use a bedside table, apart form that it was great.
Very comfortable! Bathroom was fully renovated! No coffee machine

The location was exceptional, with short walks to many of the most famous museums and tourist attractions, along with excellent restaurants. The host was extremely helpful, providing many tips for sightseeing. No comments
Great client service and location. Beds confortable

We have stayed in many apartments while travelling and this is one of the most beautiful. Very spacious and elegant and comfortable and with very good air conditioning. It really feels like you are in a neighbourhood but close enough to the subway to easily get to Milan's main sites. Unfortunately, there was a water leaking issue while we were there but the owners were on top of it and helped us find another place within hours and fully refunded our stay. We were just sad to miss some nights in this beautiful apartment!
The location is near the train station and bus. A lot of good restaurants near the hotel. Very nice,clean and homey feeling inside the hotel. Highly recommended.

Ok hotel if you need something for a very short stay near the airport. The hotel does have a bus stop to Venice right across the street, which was very convenient. The bus runs every 20 min depending on the day and time. Parking is also available, you leave your key with reception in case they need to move your car. Parking is small and only for small cars. Small fridge was in the room with 1 free water. Room was clean but outdated. Hotel is very outdated and needs some improvements. Room washroom was incredibly small. Shower could barely fit one person. If you are tall or over 200lbs, you will have issues. Safe in the room didn't work. Breakfast you order the day before and service was mediocre. They forgot some items or ran out of items even if you asked for it. Selection and food was very basic. Tasted like store bought items and not fresh. There is also no elevator, thankfully the reception staff helped carry the bags up the stairs to the room.
The property was stunning and in an amazing location. The design was incredible. The staff were also very friendly and helpful. Nothing

Room was small but location was great. They had individual at the front desk to greet and explain, bonus, individual was able to help when needed some information. I think updating the main corridor to the suites is crucial, as tourist that travel a distance what clean and inviting.

It’s about 20 minutes walk from the train station. Very noisy, you can hear the tramway all day/night. Beds are hard. Front desk staff not friendly at all. Can be more clean (the floor was sticky from previous guests?)
The staff was great.

Room is a classic Italian decor. Very spacious and clean. Room service was excellent and we had excellent service at breakfast and reception. Getting a chair/bed at the beach club was very easy as we had a room and the staff truly cares. Everything was great
Super clean apartment,very close to the beach and downtown. The breakfast was well served,and delicious. Thank you Marta! Nothing to complain.

The location was perfect and the shuttle service back and forth from the parking lot was incredible. Wonderful breakfast as well. Hats off to all the staff who made our stay amazing. Loved everything about Ostuni and this hotel.
The room was very clean, and the staff was amazing.
Great location and good breakfast, especially terrace were the meal was served.
Location. Quiet but close to the beaches and restaurants. Free bikes for moving around. Private exit to the backyard from the room. Air conditioner option was nice during hot days.
So close to the Vatican! Great room and the host was friendly and helpful!
location Old interior. The power outlet in the bathroom was loosely hanging by the wires. The bathroom door could not be locked.
Clean, spacious, modern design, friendly service, convenient location

The staff welcoming and attentiveness Please note following not a reflection of the team, hotel would benefit of some upgrade of restaurant area however view from room and as mentioned above team was excellent
Breakfast included

Everything , they are caring about details Sajeev is a Star , very helpful and responsive gentleman Nothing , even the location is a pit far from center but metro station surrounding the accommodation

This was perfect for our needs. The location couldn’t be better, breakfast was very good, and the staff were warm and welcoming. We spent most of our days hiking, so we only needed a clean, comfortable place to rest, and this delivered exactly that.

We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. The location is truly excellent — just steps from a private beach, which made it perfect for relaxing. There are also many things to do in the area, and it’s only about a 10–15 minute drive to Pescara, which was very convenient. The hotel itself is clean and well-maintained. Our room was spacious and comfortable, and the breakfast each morning was absolutely delicious — a great way to start the day! The only downside was the pool policy: guests are required to wear a swim cap, and if you don’t have one, they charge you hourly for it, which felt a bit excessive. Otherwise, everything else was great.
Wonderful stay, really clean with good space and host was very kind and helpful! They also provided water!

The charm of being a family-owned hotel, it was such a cozy experience for me as a solo traveller. The hotel had very friendly staff, and every morning the breakfast was wonderful. The location is really good, a few minutes away from the ferry terminal in Bellagio, you get a great experience of staying in central Bellagio. I loved my stay here. Thankful to the staff and everyone who greeted me each day with a smile :) When they came to know that I was leaving early the next day, they arranged an early checkout breakfast for me. Much appreciated! p.s. the restaurant behind this hotel is also amazing, their ravioli was heavenly! Nothing not to like :)

The breakfast was perfect. Just elaborate enough so we had something different each day but also not overwhelming. The breakfast room never got noisy or too busy to get a table. I loved being able to walk to the hotel from the train station and the room was remarkably quiet. This was out of the throng of central Rome but an easy walk, or even quicker Metro ride.

Very clean and well located to the bus and a very good restaurant down the street. Flexible with early check-in. Pleasant outdoor seating for the garden unit. Missing some key necessities--more dishwashing tabs needed, no dish soap or paper towels provided. Would benefit from providing a few things, such as salt and pepper, tea, coffee and filters. A little frustrating not to have these things provided as they were readily available every other place we stayed.

Breakfast was okay. It was located near a street with many shops and dining spots. Not too far a walk tyo old historical centre. We experienced a very long and dangerous walk along a busy highway with .5 meter wide shoulder from bus drop-off to get there. Dodging construction materials in stair hall was unpleasant. Worse was huge deposit of well established black mold growing in washroom and starting to spread to the bedroom. Asked owner Angelo to be transferred to other room, he said none available. He told us not to worry as he would get painter in to disinfect and repaint the next day, so we slept there. I caught a minor lung infection. We stayed out all day so that the work could be done, but upon return, we saw that he had only wiped it down the mold in the washroom and you could still see it clearly. It was so bad that I had to sleep in kitchen on chairs to avoid making my breathing worse. Told him we were leaving the next morning and he asked if he could charge for both nights!!!! As soon as we left, he posted the room for rent again without cleaning it. DO NOT STAY THERE IF YOU VALUE YOUR HEALTH.
What a lovely place to stay! Loved the history The front desk was not covered around the clock. On the other hand, it could lend to the homey atmosphere!

Incredible place, the apartment was very spacious, with large rooms and a full kitchen. A nice balcony with gorgeous view of the sea and Taormina. Good location near the beach and the bus stop to Catania/Taormina. Luana was very kind and helpful, and gave us each a cute small souvenir magnet
location was great, super close to bus stop to get to venice
It was a very nice time with Domus Hostess. They did take care of us very, very well. Fantastic Breakfast!!

Off the beaten track, quiet area with easy access to Venice. Excellent restaurant recommended by staff did not disappoint. A detailed map with points of interest near hotel including basic transportation hubs
Nice and clean. Very crowded area.
Super cute place, easy to get to from ferry, bus, airport or train. Giovanni was so helpful and nice 👍
Train was delayed and arrived almost midnight but host welcomed for arrival and breakfast was great and we enjoyed southern Italian breakfast. room is cozy and comfortable We hope visit again

The facility is gorgeous, full of amazing and elegant details, great breakfast, and bed The staff especially April is a gem! She goes above and beyond to help and make your time there memorable moments Using the shower was a mess, water did not run down vertically. Therefore, the entire bathroom gets wet. The premise is just amazing and well staffed, as I mentioned before. It is very close to Vatican city (22 min walking) However, it is far from other Rome attractions, It is perfect for long stays not for short stays like was our case.
Very helpful owner.

Great communication with staff for check in. Excellent location. Felt very safe. Very comfortable bed. Voucher for coffee and pastry every morning was a nice touch. Not the easiest to find but was okay! 3 flights of stairs up.

The apartment was great! Really big with great air conditioning. It was clean and comfortable for us. The bus stop right out front was great for our day trip to positano. Enzo was super helpful and had really great recommendations. The smell to walk through on the way to the apartment wad absolutely horrid! The people.below have a dog and they do not clean the excrement so it bakes in the sun and the stench would make me dread leaving and coming back to the apartment. Definitely hold your breath!

Our family took a cooking class with Paola and that was the highlight of the trip. We learned how to make fresh pasta, ragu sauce and delicious Tiramisu. The infinity pool was awesome to cool off in the high heats and the views are breathtaking.
Room was spacious and clean. Contacted staff, they either responded very late or did not respond at all.
Proximity to the aeroport. Comfortable beds. Very good air conditioner. Needs some updates.

Wonderful little place. We stayed in Le due porte. Francesca was a great host. We communicated beforehand through WhatsApp and she met us when we arrived to show us the place. She didn’t speak English, but we were able to understand using a translator app. The place was comfortable and spacious with a cute terrace and the little toiletry kit was beautifully packaged. Breakfast was excellent. You had to walk to the restaurant, but the walk was not far (500m, or 5-10 min). Breakfast included a cappuccino, croissant, juice, and miniature dessert.
An amazing and very acommodating host and a fantastic location in the centre of Lecce. We will be back for certain! Would love to have an iron available.

We loved Cadamare, and Loulou was extraordinary. Super polite, she helped us with several reservations and valuable tips. The place was very clean and beautifully decorated. Portovenere is truly special! Thank you, Loulou, and see you next time!

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful, making me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. The room was spotless and very comfortable, which made my stay even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this hotel to my family and friends, and I would definitely stay here again. X I liked everything

Excellent location right in heart of Verona old city. Comfortable bed and kitchen facilities available as well. Room is wide and air conditioned. Bathroom shower walls could use some improvement. Would suggest to add towel hooks near shower.
the bathroom in my room smelled of sewage all night long and the door had to be closed so the smell would not travel into our room and onto our clothes the smell of sewage

Pretty place. Wonderful staff. Very nice rooms. Breakfast was great. Our TV was not working so it was replaced the next morning. The area was dark and out of the way. We had to walk about 15 minutes through dark streets to get to the center. It was ok.
Breakfast was great and always gave us an easy start to the day!
The location in San Candido (which is a beautiful town) is great. Hotel is at the end of a quiet country road. Lovely helpful staff. Delicious breakfast and dinner. All good.

The location was great, and Lorenzo was very helpful. Lorenzo was upfront and honest about mistaking the room he was supposed to give my partner and I but sadly the mistake wasn't fixed and was acknowledge too late. From the beginning we had a different room from what we asked for, Lorenzo gave us a single room for a couple, which wasn't great but it wasn't horrible either, it was uncomfortable.

The views were stunning from our balcony room. The location cannot be beat. The room was comfortable and spacious with a walk in closet. We stayed in room 303 and had a jacuzzi on the balcony. Close proximity to great restaurants, train station and this hotel has direct beach and promenade access. The staff were simply amazing and went out of their way to make us comfortable. I highly recommend a cocktail by mixologist Veronica, she made amazing cocktails for us. Cannot wait to comeback!
There was a cat outside Air conditioner wasn't very strong
Always the same breakfast items. Good use some versatility Room and bed not made up on regular basis.
The choices and breakfast was very good and the service was as well.
Location and the room was clean and the balcony Wifi was soo weak,stove didnt work we ask them but they didnt fix it roo service wasnt good we were 4 nights there
Location was excellent Beautiful chandeliers all need a good cleaning. They are beautiful murano glass and could sparkle!

Everything was great! The building is beautiful. The rooms were beautiful. The bed was super comfy. The AC was a huge bonus! The fact there were stairs that may be hard on someone with joint issues (like some people in our group)

We had a wonderful relaxing stay at this family-run boutique hotel. It is really a little gem with welcoming friendly staff and a great location, hidden down the hill right next to a beautiful natural beach and two very good restaurants. The bright comfortable room with its own terrace and sea view is designed with a lovely coastal color palette, but can be easily transformed into a silent and dark space by closing the glass doors and shutters. Poseidon Thermal Gardens is only 15 min' walking distance. You have to go up and down the stairs to get to the town or back to the hotel, which we considered our daily fitness routine). Staying away from the busy tourist area felt very peaceful and tranquil. Thank you to the amazing staff who made us feel like home: Teresa, Giusy, Mario and Lina. We wish we could stay longer here. See you next time! The Cava dell’Isola hotel provides a good buffet breakfast and there is an open bar in the late afternoon/early evening. There are also two beach restaurants just down the hill, but they only offer lunch. So for dinner you have to take the stairs and walk to Citara or Forio (not far, just about 10-15 minutes’ walk).
Host was very friendly and helpful; property was incredibly beautiful and tranquil; not far from Firenze; breakfast was great. I would absolutely come back here if I visit Firenze again.

Excellent room. Everything is clean and brand new. Convenient location, very close to the train station, the subway, and the bus stop to the ferry terminals. There's a good grocery store around the corner. The breakfast was not healthy at all. Coffey was good, but the artificial croissants and sugary yogurts need to be replaced with fresh eggs, good cheese, and bread.
Very friendly people and a good breakfast. The interior decorations and the furniture are elegant and good quality.

Great apartment with views. Parking garage for car so no worries. Excellent hosts. One of the best I have ever stayed in. An elevator would have been nice for an old guy like me but hosts did help get the luggage upstairs.
Breakfast location Room small and I didn't understand ac

The room was clean, the check-in process went okay, even though the lady only spoke Italian, we managed to communicate. The location was in the city a short walk from the action. The WiFi was really bad, the download speed was really slow, I'm glad I didn't have to do an internet call. Also, the promised private parking didn't exist, we were directed to free street parking a few blocks away.
Was not able to have it since its late being serve. No English receptionist at the front desk. Both costumer n staff can't understand. Its hard to comunicàte.
Good breakfast. Pillows are terrible.

The breakfast room was very nice. The breakfast offered is quite commonly offered in hotels and has a great selection. We did not want a room for 3. I was sure I emailed and explained that a long time ago. There was an extra charge but there was hesitation to let us know the dollar difference. In the end we were offered a bottle of wine which we had not desire to have but would have preferred being charge for just the double room.

Easy location to get around... pretty town... beautiful countryside views... service perfect... breakfast was very nice and full salty and sweet! A bit deeper cleaning in the shower perimeters should be addressed, but otherwise very clean.

Our stay at Dimora Lombardi was perfect. The beds were very comfortable, the location was near everything and Llenia was very kind to us. Highly recommend this lovely place in the hearth of Matera with a stunning view on the old city and Duomo
Liked it had an elevator for luggage. Room was large and very clean. Staff was very friendly. Would recommend highly!!!

Our flight was delayed. We are glad to find there is Courtyard Marriott within walking distance to the airport. In a last minute search.The property is fantastic and staffs are friendly. We have a good rest for our morning flight. Nil

The vacation rental was as advertised and more! The hosts were responsive and helpful in all ways. From the welcome basket to being picked up at the bus station when we first arrived, our hosts showed great attention to detail and charm.

We booked another hotel and the A/C was broken so at 7pm we needed to find another option. I booked Grottini Luxury Suites and called them to confirm our booking, after explaining our situation Francesca was amazing she was able to get us checked in within 5 minutes (no joke). Her and Simone were on top of making sure we where happy with the accommodation. They even came to our room a 10:30pm to finish our check in. The next time we travel to Rome this will be the only place we will book!!! Nothing
No coffee machines
Immaculately clean. Many provisions. Ideal location. Easy to deal with. Enjoyed alot. We found mattress hard but it's a personal choice. Perhaps some photos in the guide.
The apartment was very clean rght in the old town. The staff was friendly and provided good tips for local attractions. The apartment had a kitchen and washer which was handy. Everything was great
The staff is very friendly and helpfull It is a B&B but there is no breakfast
Nice place worth the money with recommended Good
Amazing place to spend a relaxing time. Complienti

The view is incredible and the location is excellent! Very comfortable accommodation. The staff are very friendly and helpful in offering to book reservations for dinners and recommend nearby attractions and itineraries. Would recommend to anyone visiting Cinque Terre! No dislikes.

This B&B was really the highlight of my stay in Taormina. Lya is an incredible host who gives so much care and attention to the B&B and to your experience there. Really a special place! And the breakfast is lovely.

Rena Majore Country Resort is an oasis in the sardinian countryside thoughtfully designed and run by Antonio who hosted us during our stay. The resort is a quiet retreat close to amazing beaches in north sardinia, and we loved coming back to its peaceful surroundings after a long day at the beach. The resort is new and as well maintained as the photographs show. The bed was incredibly comfortable and we had a fantastic nights sleep as it is so quiet! Breakfast was consistently delicious and had a little variety every day allowing us to taste sardinias local goods. Would recommend to anyone wanting a clean, quiet and convenient stay close to amazing beaches. Everything was fantastic.

Super funky details and styling. The shared, common spaces were great. Excellent location. The street is lively with some great bars and restaurants right out front and just down the block. Fantastic. Inside, the noise was muffled. We never go to sleep before midnight so it didn’t bother us. We could hear a bit of street sound when we were going to sleep, but nothing that required earplugs. All good. The air conditioning was OK. We had to keep lowering the temperature. I don’t think it was regulating the temperature properly. And it wasn’t clear that the little kitchenette did not have a sink in the kitchenette. For our short day, that wasn’t a big deal. But, that might prohibit me from staying there longer than two nights.

Location of hotel is perfect, close to the train station, close to the vaporetto, many restaurants to choose from in the area, walking the streets around the hotel was fabulous. You can walk to Rialto bridge and to St. Mark's Square but vaporetto is very handy too. We got the water taxi from the airport and the hotel was very close to our stop. Hotel staff are warm and welcoming. Our room was ready early for us which was much appreciated. The room was clean and comfy. Everything was perfect!
In the old town. I liked everything.

Location is amazing! You are so close to everything- food, attractions, grocery stores! The staff were super helpful and easy to communicate with via WhatsApp. The apartment size was good and allowed for ample room (we stayed a week) to relax. I might have misread the description but we stayed on the 1st floor and there was no elevator, so we had to walk 2 flights of stairs. It was tricky because we had mobility issues. Other than that, this place was great!
Gino and Noemie Thank you for a great stay. My family enjoyed staying at your property.
Superb. You must stay here! 5 mins from duomo and the property is impeccable with quiet room off the street, lovely patio to chill and the best hosts. This is s hidden gem.

The location of the villa was perfect. It was close to many wineries and Pienza, but far enough of the city to be very peaceful. We had an amazing view of the fields, especially at sunset. The host was very kind and welcoming.

Lunch and dinner menu is too restricted to be able to cover a wide variety of culinary choices. E.G. not everyone enjoys seafood. It certainly served people who look forward to those selections, just not our group. The Toastie and small pizza that our group ordered for one lunch was not tasty nor palatable. Breakfast choices were fine.

Great location. Only about a 10-15 minute walk to the colloseum. Plenty of restaurants nearby. The apartment is small but clean and everything you need for a.comfotable stay. Kitchen is well furnished. Carrefour express across the street and laundromat nearby if needed. The air conditioning does not work well at all.

Clean, very nice location in the city centre of Bologna, very nice and helpful staff , parking need to reserve in advance, very nice restaurant for the breakfast The sound of people in the street can be heard and is a bit disturbing at night.
Excellent communication and facilities were perfect. Thank you!

The amazing service at our arrival by the lady...very kind...unfortunatly, can't give a good review for other front desk employes. The front desk workers besides the first lady at arrival, were just awful...no smiles, playing on their cells...seemed like they hated their job. We felt like we were bothering them.
The hospitality of my host who came to pick me up at the bus station and helped me to navigate over there. Very warm heart. Everything was goof.
the patio was very nice and relaxing. Bus service was limited but the journey was a bonus for the views to the CT showers were small

A truly wonderful retreat at the shore; great location; very nice room; great bathroom; comfortable bed. Pool is lovely and breakfast was delishious! Spa is great because you get it for an hour all to yourself !

Luciano is such a wonderful host who kept in contact with my when my flight was 15 hours late and then throughout my stay to ensure I had everything I needed. I was so thankful for his support and kindness! Also the room itself is very clean and spacious and located within easy walking distance to Via Toledo and then to the Metro as well. It is located on a fairly busy street though so bring your earplugs if you get the room on the street side. The breakfast table in the morning was such a treat! Simple but delicious cake and biscuits, along with fruit, juice and coffee, and complimentary water bottles as well. Secure access into the building and an elevator to level 3. Just a bit of noise from the traffic out front but luckily I brought my ear plugs anyways so no problem.
Great location. Perfect for pre airport. Great pool. Right by the beach. Room was a touch small.
Well located, clean, friendly staff, and very comfortable All good

Great location, end of the strip. Walking distance to lively summer nights. Beach was calm water . Large sandy shore . Sun and shade to choose from. If you’re looking for a family friendly beach stay. This is the spot.

Location was good. Room was comfortable Instructions for entry came very late causing confusion and stress. No mention in that ad that there was no reception desk. Electronic door locks were a huge problem since I did not have cell service for part of my stay.

Proximity to bus station and city centre, very clean, large apartment Train shakes every 1 or 2 hours from 6 am to 11 pm... i was so exhausted when I arrived and couldnt get much rest due to that train. After 30 hours up this is brutal. Host was very nice. I did encounter issues like the stove not working and the host came and fixed it.

Beautiful suite, spacious, large patio with one lounger and two padded chairs. Large bathroom with huge shower, plenty of hot water. Excellent air conditioning and very comfortable king size bed. Alessia was super helpful in suggesting restaurants, making reservations and was always available in whattsapp. Great concierge style service. Fassono is an excellent base to make shirt road trips from. We stayed 5 days and will return. Nothing at all. Seriously.

5 minute walk to the beach. Nice roof top seating area. Again the Booking listing misrepresents the property. I thought I was going to someone's home. It was bare bones. The room I was in didn't have a proper wall between the next room. No sound proofing at all in the building. Safe was not functional, unable to use. It took time to get a response from host. Ie for wifi or when regard to safety questions ie. Use of safe. Lack of wall with teenage boys in next room.

The warm and attentive reception by Elena. She recommended parking and provided directions from there. It's a beautiful modern space. Elegant and comfortable in the heart of Sassi Matera. The roof top patio and access to kitchen was a bonus.

Amazing communication. Agnes & Raffaella created a chat prior to our stay and provided incredible clear and concise instructions [photos & videos] on how to navigate your way to the apartment - including which water bus to take and which stop to disembark. At first, the number of messages was a little overwhelming - but simply take a moment to read them thoroughly and level of detail will be welcomed. When I had questions, they were friendly, helpful and prompt with responses. The apartment was large and comfortable - unique in that it had 2 separate bedrooms which I understand is not common in Venice. The kitchen was lovely to have - and the welcome basket of treats was a nice touch. The location of the property is ideal - a short walk from the water bus launch and a 15-20 min walk to St Marks - perfect for discovering the labyrinth of Venice. Incredible hospitality. Thank you!!! The Booking.com listing for this apartment was somewhat confusing as the property management company has multiple properties, so we were not aware of the the actual location of the property until after we confirmed the booking. Not a biggy, as we loved the area - but be aware for anyone who has specific location needs or wants. Also - the apartment is located on the first floor - which means up one flight of stairs. [ground floor is "0"] I don't believe this was noted in the description, but be mindful if accessibility is a concern. Lastly, be prepared to pay the 4Euro/per person/per night, city tax in cash on day of departure. This was noted in the booking confirmation, but a detail easily forgotten.

The location is ideal for anyone flying in or out of Malpensa. Marina and Mamica were excellent hosts and made us feel very appreciated. We had a superb dinner in the restaurant and all the breakfast amenities were in our room at arrival. Overall an ideal stay and we would highly recommend.
Location and water station on each floor
A very kind and helpful family who own the Villa !!

Great location to access the light rail and train. One shared small refrigerator in the common area. It should be one mini refrigerator inside each unit. The coupon for breakfast should be for cafe or jus (since the children don't drink cafe).
The reception was friendly and helpful.
The host was very friendly and helpful. Excellent location overlooking the Port and ocean. It was very well equipped, modern and clean. We had an excellent 3-week stay.
Excellent location, clean room, situated close to all tourist attractions.
Great service. Room a bit small. Air conditioning limited.

It was superb experience to stay at this very beautiful apartment in Rome. For me, it looks like I lived in another museum at this marvelous city. It really exceeded my expectations. The location is great, just few minutes from Metro station. The area has a lot of groceries and restaurants. The cleanliness of the unit is great and everything was super convenient to us. The host kept communicating with me to ensure my comfort and he answered my questions immediately. Absolutely nothing.

The apartment was perfect for a short stay with a small equipped kitchen, clean space, and comfortable bed. The host was happy to accommodate our late check-in time (we arrived around 20:30). There is a bar just below the apartment with delicious croissants and coffee, however, the noise of the bar may make it difficult to fall asleep for early and light sleepers.
Good sized rooms. Lockers available.

Location was a car drive from Montepulciano. The breakfast was horrible. For an eco friendly hotel, the entire breakfast was from a package. Nothing fresh, no fruit or yogurt. We got there a little early before 3pm and felt as if we had woken up the reception staff. No entry until after 3, we were turned away. The service was lacking. Hotel was ok.it was clean and quiet. The grounds were ok, the pool needs maintenance. The pool attendant was great but the reception was awful. The breakfast was horrible

Location Small rooms. Terrible food breakfast and outside bar bq Food was cold . Bread choices slim fruit very little choices. In room lack of toilet paper -tissue- shampoo shortage. Terrible service .

I loved the city:) The rudeness from the old lady in the morning during breakfast. Extremely rude when asked for a coffee or anything from the breakfast menu and demanding. Really starts your day on a bad foot. We thought it was just with us but she was like that with everyone there.
Staff was great, Location was great, breakfast was great. One thing is they could be more clear about what they charge to park a vehicle in the back, but overall would definitely stay again.
breakfast was lovely, bed was so comfortable and clean hotel gym could've been bigger and it would've been nice for the spa to be included for guests rather than an additional charge

The owner's wife was nice If I could put less than poor I would do it. There was mold in the shower. Shower door broken. Bathroom is so small, my knees touched the wall. For breakfast, a very small coffee and a donut. No plates or glasses available. They advertised free wifi but it didn't work. When we told them, they removed the modem. We arrived late and send them an email stating so and when we arrived they cancelled our booking and demanded cash. Now we are fight booking.com to get our money back. They promised to bring us to the airport and when we called the day before, they told us that we were in our own and call a taxi. All and all really bad hosts and to me scammers.
Location, cleanliness, shuttle to airport.

Claudia was an excellent host! She met us near the apartment and walked us to the property. There were treats waiting for us in the kitchen and water and juice in the fridge. The apartment was large and bright and had an absolutely beautiful rooftop terrace. The location was excellent - very close to centro storico and many excellent restaurants. We really enjoyed our stay at this property! Nothing!
Excellent breakfast, location, facilities and overall service. The owner was super accomodating and lovely. I can't recommend this place enough.
Location was great. 1 minute walk to the beach! Perfectly tucked in. Had everything we could need around us. Town shuts down really early but that’s not the hosts fault!

The room and staff were amazing. There are many restaurants in the area and you can walk to any of the attractions quickly. Would have been nice to have coffee refreshed daily. At least 4 pods per day would be nice. You only get 1 allotment when you arrive, but it is not enough
Great location; close to waterfront and restaurants.
Lucia at the front desk is fantastic! Very kind and helpful.
beautiful clean place with amazing caring staff

Thank you to the staff for being so kind and hospitable. They are super helpful with recommending restaurants and activities around Naples. I was a vegetarian and they gave me recommendations for restaurants that served awesome tradition Neapolitan dishes. They were also able to arrange for taxi service to/from train station and the airport, as well as arrange tours. I would also rate the location a 10/10 , it has great views of the Vesuvius and is super close to Piazza del plebiscito. This was my second time staying at the location, and would gladly choose it for future trips. My favorite part is having breakfast in their garden :)
Food exceptional Great massage Comfortable room Great smelling products Slippers in the room for going to the pool

Location is excellent. Lovely neighborhood just outside of the tourist zone. Beautiful park nearby with turtles swimming around. Cheap cappuccinos. It’s a short walk to city center. Shopping is okay. Tough to find stuff that isn’t cheap and overpriced but classic tourist shopping. Some hidden gems scattered throughout. Beautiful place to walk around. Bed wasn’t very comfortable. Kitchen did not have a pan. Small things. Apartment is lovely.

The view is of course spectacular! Location is great for seeing many areas nearby...parking is available near stay...Aldo and Maria were fabulous, very helpful and courteous! Maria recommended the beach in Sori which was very enjoyable. Mishaps were taken care of super promptly and Aldo even upgraded our coffee machine, which was amazing and so appreciated! We feel the cleanliness could have been a bit more thorough and the couch was really in need of replacement...A remodel of the whole apartment should be considered, in my opinion. Also, putting gravel, or stones, onto the little grassy patio would help in being able to enjoy it without getting bitten alive. Another consideration, making the light right near the balcony gate a sensor one would help in the enjoyment of the window/balcony in the evening.
Nice staff, even gave us a bag of snacks for breakfast. Nice green space outside with a courtyard. Beds were decently comfortable, rooms were well sized. Good value overall.

Very clean and spacious. Great for young families with small children. It's nice and quiet. The host is very responsive and accommodating. Even though we had a bit of an odd arrival and departure time, she was able to help us with our luggage. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It is slightly out of the main attractions. However, it is close to two metro stations that are very accessible.
Fantastic host Lucrezia!!! Everything was good
Very friendly & hospitable host! Room was excellent, stunning views!

Staying at Antico in Polignano a Mare was truly a dream come true. Ever since I first saw photos of the dramatic cliffs in this beautiful town, I knew I had to visit—and celebrating our 1st anniversary here made it all the more special. We stayed in the Seaview Suite, and it was everything we hoped for and more. Waking up and going out to the terrace for the sound of the waves, breathing in the fresh sea air, and watching the sunset over the cliffs with a glass of wine—those are moments we’ll never forget. The views are absolutely breathtaking, both in the morning light and the golden hours of evening. What made our stay even more memorable was the warm and welcoming hospitality from Emio and his team. They were so friendly, funny, and accommodating throughout our entire stay. Whether it was answering questions, helping with directions, or even willing to provide assistance with getting to and from our vehicle, they went above and beyond to make us feel at home. If I could give more than 5 stars to Emio and the team, I would! Antico is the kind of place that not only delivers on its promise of stunning views but also wraps you in genuine care. I can't wait to come back one day again! <3
We liked everything about Hotel Continental The staff are extremely friendly Luca suggested a nice restaurant which we really enjoyed

It's in a good location, was a nice big apartment. The AC wasn't functional, the bathroom sink water was not draining, washing machine was not functional. Unfortunately with the heat and no AC, we had to move. At least property owner is refunding us. Our vacation didn't start off well in Venice. Owner should take the time to fix all that's non functional before renting it out
Really great location and comfortable hotel. The staff were very friendly and accommodating.

The location is great. The apartment unit is spacious for the 4 of us. During our stay, the down spout of the AC unit was being fixed and we had to keep emptying the water in the bowls so water doesn't overflow.

This property is absolute perfection. The room was extremely clean, the bed was insanely comfortable, the AC worked perfectly, and best of all we had a gorgeous view of the city. It was quiet, but still extremely close to everything (like the train station, and the beach). The host was extremely kind and helpful, and gave great advice. This was the best place that we staying during our Italy trip. Everything was perfect.

Family run and they are very helpful and friendly ! Too high tech for us older folks- the doors/windows have to be fully closed and locked in a specific UPRIGHT handle position for the AC etc to work - they need more labelling on the doors/windows to explain. Fridge didn't work and they forgot to fix it.

The owners were exceptional and very supportive and friendly. We enjoyed our conversations with them and to see the metal work around the property. The morning staff was incredible and willing to make our breakfast as we wished. The room was completely outfitted for quick meals or simply resting. It seems a silly point but there were no hooks or racks to hang wet towels in the washroom - as a result, they were spread around the room which was already congested with our luggage and possessions or hung over the windows.
It was great Nothing
The property was beautiful and well maintained Historic sites close by Close to the main square Luggage storage and airport transfer Helpful and kind host Full kitchen including dishes and cookware

All the staff were friendly and welcoming. The location was very central to the beach and the main strip. Beds were comfy, entire hotel was very clean. Everything! Especially the location and the staff. No wifi in our room.

Both breakfast and dinner were excellent, with well-prepared dishes served in a calm, comfortable setting. We really enjoyed the pools, especially the outdoor one: spacious and relaxing. The private beach is small but pleasant. The staff across the hotel were consistently professional, and every time we made a request at the front desk, there was clear follow-up. When my brother-in-law booked the room (with my credit card) NO WHERE does it state this is not a hotel in the traditional sense. When we arrived, we couldn't find the door and when someone finally showed up and opened the door, we were ushered into the foyer - and I noticed two very long, narrow staircases. I have a disability in which I cannot climb stairs (I have artificial knees that are now breaking down.) I was so heart-broken. The lady who came to meet us said there is no elevator and I could not get my money back. I asked why isn't this in any information on the company site? Had I known I couldn't utilize due to disability I would not have booked. Now I'm out of pocket for a room I never got to enjoy. The company should make an effort to explain this major detail AT THE VERY TOP OF THE PITCH. I read the Bookings.com listing and it appears I'm ready a traditional hotel, when this is not. I travelled from Canada. I'm sure the rooms are lovely but I'll never know because of those darn stairs. And I'm out of pocket now. There should be some type of warning available. Staying at Villa Rosa in Santa Maria De Castellabate was the highlight of my solo Italian trip in May. I had spent a few weeks exploring key highlights across Italy and this was a perfect way to wind down in the beautiful Cilento coast. I feel Cilento is underrated with its emerald, pristine beaches (mindblowing!). Every single day at Villa Rosa was memorable. I am thankful to Jamile who helped me book a taxi to&fro from Agropoli, she took care that I was taken well care of, gave me a few tips to explore nearby San Marco, Castellebate town up the hill (a must-see). She helped me rent a scooter from a local company and I loved every single day of exploring small coastal towns nearby-- a great break from the touristic, crowded Amalfi places. Villa Rosa residence has such beautiful rooms, I had booked the one with the terrace so I could relax enjoying the pool view with a cuppa. The room had everything- a stove, a mini-kitchen where I enjoyed making my breakfasts before I began my day. I even took a few swims and enjoyed the pool at Villa Rosa. The villa is centrally-located right across the sea, so beautiful views as you step out; the town is charming & historic. An unbelievably "tranquillo" experience of Cilento- definitely recommended! Loved it, nothing not to like.

I think it is more like a restaurant than a hotel with some rooms available for rent.
