Overall, this is a beautifully maintained apartment that combines style, comfort, and convenience with exceptional guest service. We would highly recommend Be Mate Trastevere to anyone visiting Rome.

Our stay exceeded our expectations. Stefano and Angelo are amazing hosts, making sure that all the details are taken care of. The home is warm and cozy and beautifully decorated. The home and the grounds are well maintained. Our room was spacious and very clean. We had breakfast in the garden every morning and there were many delicious options to choose from. We were close to the bus stop and the metro was a short walk. Easy to get around and not far from the Duomo and main attractions. Grazie mille!! Nothing

Wonderful location, beautiful views. Clean and beautiful house. Very friendly owners. Very friendly free breakfast service at the Max Cafe. Georgia was great. Would love to come back. Some construction going on outside early in the morning. Didn't bother us too much though.
Close to everything. Everything was clean. Comfy and spacious. Great place to stay! The locks were a bit of a challenge to figure out. Especially door to building. Only real complaint
Every things was perfect,Bori was the best host she explained every thing we ask.location was perfect,near to every thing,room was so clean.THANK YOU DEAR BORI Nothing to tell

Breakfast was absolutely amazing, offering every option you could imagine, with seating right by the pool and garden area—truly a dream. Both pools were stunning and incredibly serene, surrounded by lush, beautifully maintained landscaping that made the whole property feel like a paradise. My partner and I ended up spending so much time just enjoying the hotel because the atmosphere was so relaxing, cappuccinos and snacks by the pool with beautiful weather. The rooftop hot tub and patio area were also a major highlight and added an extra touch of luxury to our stay, there's panoramic views of the water, mountains, and city. We want to go back!! Nothing, everything was amazing.

Clean, bright, nice facilities (dishes, clothes washer, mini fridge, etc.). Easy to enter. Close to Centrale stn and Hop On Hop Off Stop. The lift was working. I cant think of anything we didnt like. Wish we could stay longer here.
Everything is fantastic great place to go Everything is great !
The facility is very close to the subway station and about 300 meters from the Vatican. Perfect location.

The hosts sent us a code for the building door and told us where we could find the key to the apartment. We called it our 'Santa' key because it was a large old fashioned key that everyone thought was fun. It was easy to find and in a great location with stores and food right outside. We need band-aids and toothpaste and there was a pharmacy right across from our apartment. We loved Venice and this location. We could easily walk to everything and of course took a gondola ride on the last day for enjoyment! We had a bit of a walk to/from the train station with our bags, but there are plenty of water taxis and help available if needed. Having a full table and chairs and kitchen was great for our family to spread out and cool off after sightseeing. Having a washing machine was a great help as we needed to wash a few items of clothes from our last city. The location is walkable to so many great sights of Venice and there is a lot of food and shopping close by, but also lots of bridges and water you can enjoy close by as well. The chairs at the table were a bit tricky, just need to be careful as the legs of the table don't fit the chairs. The dishwasher wasn't working but that wasn't an issue for us as we didn't cook, just needed to handwash a few glasses. The pull out sofa wasn't as comfy because there was a large space between the cushions and the back of the couch that didn't seem like we could change. The main guest bedroom with double bed was quite firm. Some may like that, but it was bit too hard for my husband and I.

Very modern room, private gated parking. A short walk straight to the beach and restaurants. The hostess was very helpful in making sure our stay was stress free. I recommend it for a nice beach vacation. Parking a little tight but we made it work.
Good

Nice, quiet, comfortable mid-range hotel showing its age a bit Seem to be modernising bit by bit (e.g. electric external window blinds) Bike-friendly with bike storage in basement Very good restaurant with a nice covered terrace for dinner Very good breakfast (except müsli had run out and no refill)

We loved everything!!! If you are looking for someplace to relax ..this is the place for you amongst the olive groves. Santa and Pietro were so informative about the property and any questions we had about the area. Santa took us on an amazing tour of the olives groves and explained how olive oil was made years ago and present time. The pool was lovely and the food incredible. We highly recommend Masseria Valente to anyone who just wants to unwind and relax.
Beautiful place
Great location No laundry, no outdoor garden space, could not find anyone to purchase extra coffee.

The size of the bathroom was great! Was worth giving up a little space in the room for that. Lovely shared balcony. It was clean and organized. There was a big complimentary bottle of water in the shared fridge in the common hallway (we looked around but wouldn't have realized there was one unless we had). There were bagged croissants and pastries if you wanted them as well. Free parking situation at ground level was great. Super close to the hotel (less than 5 min) so good for quick flights out, especially early morning flight. Perfect for our one night stay before flying out early. Close drive to many restaurants and beach. A little shelf by the bed like a nightstand, somewhere to put a phone, etc. At time of booking you need to make people aware that arrival is all online automated only (we were expecting a person to be there similarly to our other bookings) and you need internet access to check in and get into the building so if you don't have access to the internet on your phone other than Wifi, you won't get in. Advise people that there will be videos to get in. Also tell people to text the whats app number not call. Our calls went unanswered. Texts were answered within 10 min or so. Thankfully we ran into a couple leaving the apartment who said they had similar issues and not to call but text. This type of information should be shared prior to booking confirmation. We did see kids peeing on the walls outside the building but inside was clean and smelled clean!

Nice location not in the center of the old city but reasonable walking distance to Mercato Centrale and Sant Lorenzo Church. The person at the reception provided us with the room cards, showed us the room and provided us a city map with some recommendation for restaurants , gelato and important city land marks
Location, cleanest it's was just an amazing experience

The location was perfect for our visit; it was a quick stop before travelling to our next destination (only 1 night). * Great shops and easy to walk around. * Alexandro was fabulous - He greeted us, shared the history of the property (amazing), helped us book a taxi for 5 am the next morning. We're very grateful for his service and the early check-in. As mentioned, the property is very well-maintained; perhaps it's just a matter of personal comfort preferences, especially with our picky teenagers and us being older parents :) We found the beds to be somewhat less comfortable than we had hoped for. If we were staying longer, it might have posed a bit of a challenge.

Great location, 8 min. from Iseo. Simple but very clean. It has all the basics you need. AC, large shower, clean towels and linen, sofa, TV with local channels. Semi hard mattress and thin pillows. Armoire. No fridge. It is family owned, they are lovely. Breakfast was good. No signs as you arrive. A little confusing to find.

Big room, good a/c, coffee, location Poor setup to get into your room. A lot of stairs!! Waited outside on the street for 2 hours trying to reach someone to let us in our room. Loved the people and the location!!! Hard time getting our room to cool down

It is a very beautiful place, about ten fifteen minutes to two interesting town. Very quiet and clean. The host is a nice and helpful person. If I was to go back to Puglia. I would not hesitate and rent at Trulli House. The pool is particularly appreciated. I liked everything at this place
Small, family-run establishment, quiet area. It was a short stay but we would definitely come back given the oportunity. Nothing! It was lovely.
Very friendly staff. Excellent breakfast and dinner package. The facilities are comfortable and modern and they aim to meet every need of travellers.
Amazing place with fabulous views and landscapes!!
Amazing location! Very welcoming and friendly! So clean and well kept!

The apartment was spacious and clean, the host provided some delicious snacks and water for our stay. The location was perfect, only 10 minutes from the port and surrounded by restaurants. It was perfect for our stay. Everything was perfect.

Very loud in the hallways, at all hours. There was a sign to put out if you wanted housekeeping, when we didn’t put it out - the staff still came and knocked on the door in the morning when we were trying to sleep.
Great location, historic property with character, good amenities. No service provided by the staff that we had to communicate with, restrictive requirements to advance city tax via PayPal in advance.

The hotel is very well situated, quiet and calm, and straight next to the main city center street. Staff is super nice and cleanliness is amazing. The panoramic pool on the roof is where you should be!

The staff and service was exceptional, rooftop pool and lounge area stunning and our room was fabulous- outdoor terrace with a hot tub and beautiful lemon and orange trees. Close to main attractions ....you can walk to everywhere Elevator to small
Location. Cleanliness. Room. I would have liked the bathroom in the room.

The breakfast was great. The staff were helpful. Thank you. I would have used the gym if it were open at 6 or 7am. The gym would normally open at 8am, it is too late for me.
Staff were super nice. Place was clean, modern and quaint
Great location. Close to everything in Treviso. Large room, large bathroom. Comfy bed. Water drainage in bathroom sink and shower was poor.
Private room. If you travel with a bigger group you can book 2 rooms or 3 if available.nice Kitchenette. Short walk to old town and sea side . Grocery store downstairs is very convenient None

Hangar Inn is very well located, just a few kilometres from the Rome-Fiumicino airport and accessible through a local cab or bus, both of which have stands at the lower level of Terminal 3 Arrivals. The room was quite large, and included several bottles of water for free, as well as tea and a kettle. A collection of packaged breakfast foods was provided, which will give you a nice start to the day. It is just a 3 minute walk to the nearest supermarket, and there is a mini-fridge in the room which makes it very easy to grab bread or meat, or accommodate an allergy. The Hangar Inn can also help you call a taxi for a specific time, which is very helpful. The hosts were very helpful and friendly as well. While I was unable to see it myself due to timing, the Port of Claudius and Trajan, which is the ancient main harbour of Rome, is close to the Hangar Inn and is one of the most overlooked sets of ruins in the area. This makes Hangar Inn extremely well located for the airport, seeing the city of Fiumicino, and for archaeological sites. I would absolutely recommend the Hangar Inn, and stay again if I had the choice. I liked everything.

Great location with lots of restaurants within walking distance. Breakfast was served in beautiful restored building in the property. Amazing breakfast with lots of sweet and savoury choices, fresh fruit, delicious variety of croissants, and best cappuccino! Pool area had amazing mountain views. Location was a few min drive away from beautiful sandy beach called Spiaggia Playa. We had one room facing the marina which we knew could be extra noisy and on Monday night was especially noisy with motorbikes riding up and down the marina well into 2am. Maybe hotel could supply ear plugs. Would suggest they add more chairs near the pool or even in the courtyard.

The apartment was extremely clean, it had everything that you could ask for if not he would provided for us, and the host was very kind and respectful. He also provided us with complimentary snacks.😍😍😍😍😍😍
Wonderful hotel with a great restaurant and pleasant staff.
Staff friendly. Quiet neighborhood and close to everything.

Everything from the included snacks and drinks, to the included buffet breakfast. It was well worth it. We also stayed in for dinner and El Porto was superb Nothing much
Very nicely equipped room with a very comfortable bed. 2 bathrooms are available. Kitchen and dining room are great.

Very nice, renovated apartment located just outside of the old, historic centre of Rieti, a stone's throw from the Museo Civico, and quite near to the Velino River. Best for a couple or a couple with one or two small children who will sleep together on the pull-out sofa-bed. The apartment is very comfortable with lots of seating, a great kitchen, and it is easy to keep cool on a hot day. The only downside is the lack of nearby parking for those with a car. This would likely only be an issue for those with traveling with small children or with mobility issues.

Lovely place nestled high above the sea with spectacular views of Taormina. Decent pool and pool deck. Very calm and quiet ..nice ambiance to it. location dirty, dusty, musty,

Roberto provided great instructions on how to find the property and was very receptive to any questions we had. The suite was very nice and comfortable. Everything we needed for our stay was provided. Nothing, it was great

The staff is super nice and helpful, I will highly recommend this place.

Incredibly kind, attentive and friendly staff. The b & b is located in a beautiful garden that's away from the hustle and bustle of Sorrento itself, but still very accessible. I was greeted with lemonade and chocolate cake upon arrival, breakfast was amazing, and on the one day I had to leave too early for breakfast, I was provided with breakfast "to go". The room was quiet, comfortable, and I slept very well. Highly recommend.

The room was very clean and well appointed for business or personal travelers. We did enjoy the breakfast which was reasonably priced. First, Valeria was a wonderful host. Her communication was excellent. She was so kind and generous; we enjoyed talking with her at breakfast. The breakfast was excellent and plentiful. The location was great - we could walk everywhere! And the apartment itself was glorious! We do not have anything about it we didn't like.

Christian was really nice warming up our food when we arrived.
Great Location clean hotel good breakfast and friendly staff
Near to metro station and free locker. So old. No elevator. Only 2 bathrooms.

Cozy and clean place, nice & polite staff. Good location, parking, wifi, and above all, nature nearby The Booking.com property address needs to be updated.

Good We had a little trouble finding it. There was hardly any toilet paper available in when we arrived.

Very clean, large 2 bedroom apartment was perfect for us.

We loved the quiet neighborhood to have a restful sleep and proximity to transit to see all the sights of Rome. It was awesome to take a dip in the pool with a bar in the mid afternoon heat! Great location with nice view of a small garden. Good variety. Coffee was excellent. Liked the bacon and eggs. Lots of fruit, pastries and really enjoyed the breakfast sandwiches. I have nothing negative to say.

Excellent views from our balcony- breakfast was excellent and food/drinks wonderful as well. We did have an ant issue in our room but the manager did comp our parking and bar bill for our stay.

Carolina was helping us with everything and answered all our questions. The room was in the centro so perfect location. La terrazza with la collazione was beautiful. There was a lot of water on the floor after the shower.

on the second floor, room 35. The host (Guiseppe) met me at the property on the day of a 24hr national transportation strike which meant I arrived by train at 9am (from Bergamo) instead of 3pm - during the heatwave. He allowed me to check in at 12noon (instead of 3pm) and that was truly appreciated. Not saying he does that for everyone but it demonstrates a quality of host that's become rare. The photos don't do the apartment justice: the decor is truly class and although it's cosy, it's much bigger than expected. It's also dead quiet (for somewhere so central) and very well equipped for a 9-night stay during a heatwave with top quality bed/bath linen and mattress/pillows, a waterfall shower in a large bathroom (by European standards), blackout shutters and excellent AC. The flat is 52 steps up from the front door (3rd floor) but you get used to it and you're rewarded by the light, the high (beamed) ceilings, the balcony, the outlook and the atmosphere. The icing on the cake is the location: so close to the station, the historical centre, grocery stores (Conad, Carrefour and the Central Market), the river (gorgeous promenade) and the direct bus No. 12/13 to Piazzale Michealangelo (the park with the best views of Florence) for 1.70euro is at the corner. Awesome! I highly recommend this gem of a place.

The garden, the sea view, the terrace, the living room. Kitchen was well equipped. Rooms without windows, small bathrooms, small kitchen. Also, with a hefty 300€ administration fee, I would expect the staff to take care of disposing the garbage.
Very nice place in a great location! The host was very helpful and welcoming. There are a lot of great places to eat within a few minutes walk.
Amazing high quality breakfast! I’m still thinking about it!

Near the storic center and walking distance to the grotte de catulo. Staff is very friendly specially the 2 ladies at reception. Pizza was delicious. Bedroom was comfortable and quiet. Wish there was a mug for tea instead of paper cups.

Nothing really - our unit was in a different building from reception but the staff were really helpful and walked us to our building. Location with a pool and beach is great. We found the room small as is expected in Europe, however the shower is very tiny. Difficult to get in and out and bending down is impossible.

Location was very good. Room was very nice. More of a room than apt. We needed two bed so a little tight with wall bed opened. Host was nice, not much interaction. A good place to stay for one night A bit small but beautifully decorated

Nice modern hotel. High ceilings. We were given a smaller room than I paid for because the grumpy man at the counter considered that we did not need bigger! Even if I paid to have a living room space in my room, separate from the bedroom. He gave us a double regular room. No iron in the room either.

Il Gelso is a rustic vacation spot. The staff are kind and helpful. Francesca was a wonderful host and helped us throughout our stay! The room was large, air conditioned and tidy. The beach is a 10 minute walk with many stairs to access. Bring watershoes to navigate the rocks, there are mattresses for rental. It can be difficult to get around the island at times so plan ahead and book a taxi from the ferry/hydrofoil. Plan for a more rustic family stay! Give yourself extra time to get around the island.

The hotel's location is perfect as it's right in the heart of Rome's centre so it's only about a 30-40 min walk to anywhere you want to go. We found it pretty quiet at night and didn't hear any noise from the street below. The breakfast had a decent selection. The room was spacious and clean, and the staff were really nice and accommodating. The bed was pretty uncomfortable. I had to sleep on top of the comforter I found in the armoire for more cushion, which did help. The hotel walls are pretty thin so you could hear other guests coming and going. The coffee wasn't that great and although the breakfast had plenty to offer, the hot breakfast was disappointing.
Location and staff friendliness The size of the room, especially the bathroom.

I had a wonderful stay. The rooms were spotless, comfortable, and well-equipped with all the essentials. The staff were warm, professional, and always ready to help with a smile. The location was convenient, and the facilities made the stay even more enjoyable. Everything from check-in to check-out was smooth and pleasant. Highly recommend for a comfortable and memorable stay!
The breakfast was amazing. Staff was friendly. Room was great. Need better communication regarding evening activities . Other than that we had a great time.
Our Host Francesco was very attentive even though we didn't speak the same language. Great Location. Room on the smaller side, but nothing to complain about. It's still cute and homely.

Easy to get to from airport using bus 5. It costs 10 Euros. Easy using bus 5 to get to Venice for 1.5 Euros. Shuttle to airport available for 8 Euros. Restaurant in the hotel, good food, large portions and nice variety. Clean rooms. No English Tv. Stations available on cable.
Very kind owner's made me feel at home, very helpful , excellent food and great location
Clean, relaxing and the pool was great to relax when you just wanted to cool off or rest. Not much. Everything was to our liking.

did not stay at the location. Advertised as having internet. When i got there there was no internet and i needed it to conduct communication with CDN government to updated my travel documents. I left within 1/2 hour and requested my money back. Accessibility to close by restaurants and bars.

Carlo the host was exceptional with getting us settled in the hotel. The transfer from Catania was a problem with the taxi dropping us in the wrong spot. Carlo set him straight. Location was great. Very clean. Carlo was very helpful Taxi wasn't good for my 83 year old mom

This is a super clean, large one-bedroom apartment that puts you right on top of everything you want to see in Genova after a 12 minute walk from Principe station. Transit is plentiful but we hardly needed it. It's easy to access the building and apartment with the provided code. The kitchen was set up with everything we needed for our breakfast and dinners. There is a small balcony overlooking the back of the building where we dined al fresco - very nice. The host - Maura - is terrific to communicate with: prompt to reply, helpful, professional and - while we didn't meet in person as we were so busy sight-seeing - you can tell from the 'tone' of the messages that she is a very nice person. We hope to return and stay here again and we very much recommend this apartment for your stay in Genova!!

Location was very good - its in the city center, very close to the Duomo and Galleria Emanuelle. The unit is easy to get in and out of because there are no keys, its all digital. The place was tidy upon arrival and instruction were clear. Lots of great little restaurants close by The place smells strongly of cigarette smoke—it’s like walking into an ashtray. The digital lock on the front door can be a bit tricky to use. One of the bedrooms is in the cellar, the one with the arched brick ceiling, and it was extremely damp. There is a dehumidifier, but it was turned off, and the room felt wet and musty. The unit is quite old and doesn’t always start up properly—we had to fiddle with it for a couple of hours to get it working, which is the last thing you want to deal with after a long day of travel. When we arrived, none of the AC units were on, and the entire place was sweltering. The remote for the downstairs AC was broken, but after a while we figured out we could open the panel and use the 'emergency off' button just to get it running. It functioned at a basic level, and to their credit, the host did replace the remote the next day. After a few hours of the AC and de-humidifier running, the cellar bedroom was very comfortable to sleep in. There was also no hot water in the ensuite bathroom of the cellar bedroom. We were told the hot water tank had been turned off due to a leak, but could be turned back on before each shower—then you have to wait for the tank to refill. Not ideal. Connectivity is another issue. There’s no Wi-Fi signal in the cellar at all because the modem is on the second floor, and there’s zero cell reception down there—it’s a complete dead zone. You have to go upstairs just to use your phone. To top it off, there was visible black mould on one of the walls in the main floor bathroom. While the price was relatively affordable given the location, I would not recommend this place. Too many basic issues that made the stay uncomfortable.

Location Pressure to forward passport and other ID prior to arrival. Did not comply as this is opposed to Booking.com stated policy. Created friction and multiple attempts for compliance. Dishes dirty, sheets and towels found stained. Infested with tiny ants, primarily in bathroom. Safe found locked and unable to utilize.

Excellent central location in the very middle of Cortina (right opposite church which thankfully did not have bells ringing all hours) Very friendly and helpful staff Very tastefully renovated hotel with nice wood throughout and comfortable room with modern bathroom Bike-friendly with separate garage for bike storage Extraordinarily good breakfast A little bit pricy (but realize it was the middle of the main tourist season)
Clean, spacious and beautiful room. Lovely breakfast. Excellent location and friendly and helpful hosts.

We needed a base for our last two nights in Sicily in order to be at Catania Airport to fly home on a 6 am flight. MicHouse is a lovely real home in a historic building close to (but not quite in) the tourist centre. The hosts were so great. We wanted to get rid of our rental car and Luca picked us up at the car drop and brought us to MicHouse, and he and Laura showed us the place. It's awesome. The ceilings!!! The terrasse! The kitchen is big, with a table suitable for a family, and a living room! (Our other vacation rentals in Sicily have been lovely, too, but comparatively very small. For Canadians, this felt like luxuriously roomy for our family of 4.) Luca and Laura were lovely and welcoming, and very responsive (we accidentally locked ourselves out once and Luca was there within minutes). There is a good gelateria just steps away, and shops close by. We walked down to the fish market, piazza del duomo etc. Not a bad walk (hot of course). The only thing is that because this is more "tourist centre adjacent", the first part of the walk is through a real neighbourhood. That is to say, it's a little "gritty". We like that just fine, but some people may be less excited. We were glad to have ditched the car...parking was available, but, as you know if you have driven in places like Sicily or Dominican Republic as a North American, it's just not obvious how to get in and out and it can at times be heart-stopping. One more great thing...the washing machine and clothesline. So great when travelling. It was all great.
Location and breakfast was good The room. Rather dated. Hairdryer heated up too much! Toilet paper holder was in back of toilet !!

Great location and decent amount of room. The host was there upon arrival. She gave us some good information about the area. Coffee was provided and the fridge was great to have for small items. It isn't fancy but for exploring room it suited our needs.

A most welcoming and authentic Venetian experience. Well located with its own access from the river so convenient for water taxi pick up / drop off. The staff are hospitable and highly professional. We will be back very soon. It’s all positive.

Fantastic location - close to many highly rated restaurants, dessert shops, a supermarket, Metro, and within walking distance to the main cultural sites. Nicely decorated rooms with high ceilings and air conditioning. Soft drinks and bottled water were included for free as well as alcohol and snacks in the lobby. Noise level from other guests and outside were minimal. Owner was friendly and readily available by phone. Shower was a little small although the bathroom itself was an adequate size.
Amazing location! The host, Danilo, was very welcoming and helpful with information about the area. The room was clean and spacious with a cute little balcony.

Service was outstanding (Frederico was so kind)! Room was very pretty and view from the room balcony was breathtaking. Shared rooftop balcony is also beautiful and so enjoyable in the morning and evenings! Parking situation was a little complicated, but made easier thanks to the lovely staff. Our room door was directly connected to the main lobby, which made it difficult to have any privacy or intimacy. Also, the bathroom was quite small, shower was very tight with hardly and room to move around or even open the shower door. Even the room was a bit small overall.
great location and friendly staff everything good
Everything was amazing. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They gave us great tips for dining etc. The Albergo is in a great location to explore Verona. The breakfast was great too.

Really nice appartement located on a corner of 2 steets with patio and full balcone that give.a.view on boths streets. was nice to have kitchen and washing machine for our trip , only 10 min drive to lecce old town , there is only one appartement on the second floor and we can lock a door at the stairs also so the bathroom is like part of the unit so was perfect , we could park our car right in front of the appartment easily so was nice for this a well . Bed was also big a confy . Overall Really good value if you dont mind driving 8- 10 min to visit Lecce , We would go again Everything was good , I would only recomend addind a big mirror to the unit since there is only one in the bathoom

excellent communication with host - met us on time at the apartment, really liked the fact that there was secured parking - the outdoor space was incredible and the we loved the decor and space inside the apartment. we only stayed 1 night but it is close to easy access onto the beach and to all the restaurants we enjoy. we will be back nothing

We had a terrible time finding the location, we walked in circles for an hour. The host sent us an email requesting further info when we were in transit so we did not get it until we were hunting for the location. Although we were told it was on the second floor we were not warned that it was 57 steps up, a hard climb after a long day. The room was very clean but we could not get in until David got all the information. It is hard to think when you need the washroom! Receiving the detailed info more than 1 day ahead would be helpful. A detailed map of the location would have been helpful. Also tell people that there is a tram station 2 blocks away.
The rooms are very nice and spacious. The location is convenient for strolling around and seeing all the glass shops. If you want somewhere a bit more quiet, this is the place for you.

Location, breakfast, both excellent. Afternoon receptionist; Anta very hospitable. Evening receptionist very inhospitable and his chronic smoking just outside lobby may have been cause of fire alarm activation I suspect. Air conditioning not working. Fire alarm activation at 3:30am without cause or explaination
Did not have breakfast. There was really nothing that I didn’t like.

- very clean - nice location - friendly staff - facilities could use some renovations, in our first room; the AC wasn't working the staff were cooperative and gave us another room where the AC was working but very loud

Rooms are very clean,the front desk staff (Nicoleta)always helpful with a lot of information. At the breakfast,Cristina always with a smile was taken care to have everything what we needed. That means a lot for the customers. This place could be easy become a 5 Star for service,cleanliness and location. Nothing to complain!

The room was nice, we had a little fridge and our blind didnt work well but they fixed it when asked for it. Really close to the metro!!! That we had a private bathroom but everyone had access to it. I would add also more stuff for us to cook or clean! If we have a fridge would love plates and forks 😂
Rooms are nice and clean, the host was very co operative and helpful
The location was excellent. The air conditioner was so perfect as it was almost 38° the night we stayed. Our host Erika was so sweet and met us outside the apartment. Nothing

Loved this hotel, the location was great, we could easily walk to all attractions. There was also a daily market where we bought fresh fruits every day. It was so clean and spacious. The staff were so nice and helpful. The only thing that was a bit annoying was that the fridge didn't work.

Super clean and modern. Loved the kitchen facilities. The property manager was super accomodating. 15 mins to airport and beach! About a 20 min walk to the centre ... safe enough to walk alone if solo traveller but would have liked to be a bit closer. Street parking was a bit chaotic but there were spaces around.

Excellent hosts. They were taking care of us to a detail. Very relaxed atmosphere. We also liked the idea that in addition to breakfast that was included into the price of the accommodation, the hotel offers a 4 course dinner for an additional very reasonable price. They have an excellent chef on the premises and the food is delicious. Another point we liked is a thermal pool. Very pleasant and well kept.
It felt like an elegant Roman apartment for the modern age- all amenitites and gorgeous spacious rooms. I wish we could have stayed much longer to enjoy this fabulous apartment.
Honestly nothing Everything

A great stay in a great home with a wonderful terrace and a beautiful view from our front steps. Kitchen had everything we needed, bed was comfortable but the best part was the neighbors and especially the owner who had the house above us. We really enjoyed our month in Celano and have already rebooked LaVistaDeiSogni Filippone for a month next year. There were four of us for several days and had lots of room to get around in the home. Parking is easy if you have a smaller car but is doesn't have to be tiny. We had a VW Tiago and it was fine. As a Canadian I'm not used to scorpions but now I know to check my shoes in the morning. Didn't get stung but now I know! Only saw them a couple times in the house during our stay.
It is located just next to the Trevi. The manager is very helpful! The apartment is big enough for a family. The living condition is good but not excellent.
Beautiful property. The pool and spa are tremendous Air conditioning was not adequate

This place is beautiful. Beds are incredibly comfortable and room was spacious. The hotel is in an older building with a beautiful entrance and old school elevator. Room also had a great street view from the balcony and was close to transit. Reception staff were also incredibly helpful and provided lots of recommendations. Reception has certain hours which may be hard for some folks arriving late but I had no issues. There was great communication with the hotel.

It was a great place to rest my body after a long day of adventuring. The AC was phenomenal after a day in the heat. It was well kept and clean. There was a bit of noise from the street but I found if I closed the thicker shutter it wasn't horrible. The host was helpful and welcoming. I would stay again if I visited Catania again. The location was great for doing things around Catania however, it was a bit of a walk to the train station..
Family run, spoke English and very accommodating. Walking distance to all the major sites.

Location was absolutely perfect. 4min walk to train station. 2min walk to waterfront. 10mins to Ferry. Great restaurants and bars around. We moved from our original room in the older part of hotel as the room was just too small and not enough space for us. Staff very accommodating and moved us to New part of hotel which was fabulous. Old part of hotel is very old. Rooms are small so unfortunately little space for cases and no drawers. Very clean but all original. No coffee machine or kettle in room. Would be nice to have larger bottles of shampoo and body lotion.
Comfortable bed and a good breakfast. Location and transport.

Very accommodating and helpful, even offered to carry my bags which was unnecessary. cute kitchen with everything, AC was strong . Wish I stayed a few more days. wifi a bit weak but still fine as the room was probably furthest
Beautiful place! So clean. Surrounded by nature . Would go back again To get to the property it was a litlle challenging! You need a good car ! Other than that everything was great.

Location, near bus stop, great pizza, laundry and groceries. Excellent local vibe! Staff was super accommodating. Place was clean. Location also. It's near the road and you hear the street noise 24/7. They have a lot of ambulances that use the street in front. Bring ear plugs. Otherwise, the place is perfect.
Everything was in well working order and was a great place to stay.
Proximity of the train station Cleanliness of the room
Very clean. Easy to access. Great location. Shared bathroom facilities.

Fantastic place — truly a hidden gem in the heart of the city center. Just a short walk to all the best restaurants. The apartment far exceeded our expectations: super clean, modern, and spacious. The shower system was excellent, and having two AC units made the stay extra comfortable.
Friendly staff Calling to get in.

I stayed 2 nights.The location was perfect. Right in front of via del Corso. Quiet room; basic; clean. It was 30 degrees heat in Rome with a huge humidity. The air conditioner didn't work well. When I told Silvia about it; after we flew 20 hours to Rome, she said you dont like it- change the hotel. I think it was rude, not even trying to solve the problem. We had a tought time sleeping. I left the AC on and took 10 hours to decrease it from 30 degrees to 27 degrees. That AC is definetely not working properly and the technician needs to look at it.
The atmosphere 😊

I stayed at their sister location Monte Meraviglia as they notified me that La Corte was closed for the dates I booked. It was a much closer walk to the Basilica. Very comfortable and the restaurant has a wide selection of local specialties on the menu. Room was excellent but the highlight was the friendly waiter at the restaurant that was so welcoming and kind! Pool was also nice with an incredible view!
welcome, accomodation, location sommunication in restaurant
Waking distance to most everywhere

Super cozy place, near the Anacapri bus stops. Extremely clean, nice breakfast and Salvatore was super helpful in helping find the best places in Capri and Anacapri. Would recommend this place for sure. Nothing
Room and bathroom were nice, spacious, and clean. Bed was comfortable. We saw one beetle in our room, but it was just the one. Possible it came in during the times we left the door wide open.
Staff were very helpful - need to ask specific questions re the shuttle though. Love they had a bathtub because it is an older hotel The outside and much of the inside definitely needs maintenance !

The staff was incredible. Very friendly, professional, and willing to assist in any way. The rooms were beautiful and the location couldn't be better. Walking distance to the beach, great restaurants, and center square. The only thing for a family of 5, two bathrooms would have been perfect.

Spacious big rooms, the balcony view was stunning, especially in the morning! Especially where the rays would enter through the windows. The location is convenient, very close to the buses and trains only about a 5 minute walk. Very clean, organized, and the softest beds, absolutely lovely!
very good place, good owner and very good services
Close to Train station Breakfast Nothing
Great location and wonderful view! Comfortable bed and shower. The toilet seat was broken but that's a minor thing. Note you'll have to climb stairs! Not a problem for me though. Loved it.
Clean and comfortable great location Very expensive no hot water to take shower bidet not working definitely not 5 star
Perfect location close to the Vatican, restaurants

The rooms were spacious enough, they were clean. The location was good. The shower doesn't have a door, it is impossible not to splash the water outside. There's room service but it is for a charge, not free like a hotel. TV is too slow, can't open anything except YouTube.

Great location. The layout of the apartment is great..You can open up the door facing the center street and enjoy your drinks and meals overlooking the people walking by. We loved the access to the kitchen facilities too. Limited hot water due to a small water tank.
Location is excellent and easy to find Host is not very responsive to messages. I ran into 2 new guests who couldn't get in because the door code is wrong.
Host was very helpful. Spacious and clean room. Very relaxed atmosphere. Thank you so much! A sign at the main road would be helpful, especially if you arrive in the dark.
- GREAT LOCATION - GREAT BREAKFAST - GREAT SERVICES BY THE OWNERS

The apartment was in a perfect location; central to so many things. Pamela, who met us was lovely. The treats she left were appreciated. The ac was perfectly splendid, and it works and cools like North American ac, thankfully! We felt very safe in the location; even when we left for a couple of nights to go to Florence. If I had to say one thing, the one shower, in the main bathroom was weird, but as a family of three, we just used the other shower. It's really a great apartment, and HUGE.
Great location, lots of sightseeing within walkable distance, super markets, and restaurants The bathroom smelt bad and the shower would alternate between very hot and ice cold, bed not very comfy

Breath taking balcony views, the room was very comfortable and the bathroom was huge and spotless! Our breakfast room was adorable, we had our own fridge and coffee machine! The breakfast was great! Meats, cheeses, pasteries, fresh fruits, juices. Nothing!

This apartment is located close to the airport, which is very convenient. The property was exactly as described, clean, with everything you need. The communication with the host was exceptional, starting with the instructions on how to access the place and help with booking a taxi to the airport. Would recommend to stay.
Breakfast offering was excellent and dining area was very nice Room was very small, walls are quite thin and we could hear the occupants in neighbouring room late at night every night
Very easy to reach the airport by walk.
Location and the stuff The Matress is not in good shape
Modern, contemporary apartment that was close to the train station, restaurants, shops and the sites There was some construction on the street and the entry which will be temporary
Everything Not much

Clean, bed is comfortable. Can walk to the train station. Disturbing night light, uneven floor with a step to the bathroom. Small sink. Poor and sketchy neighborhood. No microwave , leaking coffee maker. Plastic chairs with the leg cousins kept falling off.

The breakfast had lots of selection and the location of the hotel was fantastic. Staff was very helpful. Wish we had a few more towels and there was nowhere to store anything in the bathroom. The main challenge was how loud the street noise was in the room. Sirens woke us up all night both nights.
Very clean, wonderful location. Excellent breakfast and loved the look of the hotel Nothing really.
We loved staying here. The room was big with a beautiful view of the water! The staff were helpful, and the location was really convenient. We were able to easily walk everywhere we wanted to go.

The view over the gulf of Salerno is beautiful, especially if you get one of the two rooms with balconies. First, I want to clarify that it’s not 100 stairs to get to the gate ( from via de la Republica) it’s 173 stairs to the first gate or 258 stairs to the second gate. This may be a limitation for many people. The place itself is quiet, peaceful with an incredible view over the gulf of Salerno. The breakfast is degrading, of the seven hotels we used on this trip through Europe it was the poorest of all! Considering there are no cafes or shops nearby to enhance the breakfast, they should have put a little more effort into improving it!the little they offered, even some fruit salad, or fruit of any kind, would be an improvement!

Amazing host. Newly renovated traditional home in very quite area. Beautiful terrace. The Stefania, was amazing and made us feel at home. Very comfy bed. Very nice shower. The wifi was great as well. Would highly recommend it. Nothing
Great location wonderfully staff clean place nice breez

The balcony, view and price made this place worth staying at. Signora Rosalia era molto gentile! Era uno piacere de conoscerla. Buy water bottles at the eurospin before you arrive. The tap water at the B&B is not portable, and, unlike most places in Italy, the hosts do not offer complemetary water bottles. Instead, they charge you twice the price of grocery store bottles. The breakfast is served by Rosalia who is lovely. For a B&B, we thought that the selection was lacking and surprised that everything was bought rather than fresh. That being said, we ate well and enjoyed our cappuccini on our balcony with a gorgeous view.
New, clean, cozy apartment. Very comfortable for 2 people.All the essentials for cooking. Air condition worked well. Would definitely recommend.

Unfortunately, we didn't realize that we had to arrive by 9 p.m. We saw that the booking was confirmed so we just headed to the hotel, but it was closed and we didn't get to stay there. It was extremely upsetting. I will be contacting expedia to complain about the fact that they should put the time limits right in the first bit of information. You could have an emergency number for people who arrive after 9 p.m.
Food was amazing, view from my balcony was excellent. Staff was delightful, made the stay very peaceful and easy. Not far from anything, which made the stay convenient for those traveling light.

The location was absolutely perfect. Staying in a Trullo was a wonderful experience. We couldn’t have asked for a more beautiful place. The breakfast was simple but the coffee was excellent. The owners was what made this place so special. They went out of their way to make sure that we had everything we needed. We will never forget their kindness and will definitely recommend their place to others. We loved everything at Terrazze sulla Valle.

Overall, the hotel was quite nice and I especially loved the location—it’s only about a 15-minute walk from the train station and just steps away from Coop, which made it very convenient for picking up food or groceries. Air conditioning, which wasn’t very effective, so the room stayed warm and we had trouble sleeping throughout our stay. In addition, the hotel only provided one pouch of soap and shampoo without daily refills, so you may want to bring or purchase your own toiletries such as shampoo, conditioner, soap, and lotion

the place is so secure and it was clean at the back door there is a church, it is so near St.Peter's Square and near to all important errands, souvenir stores, restaurants, bus stations, we just love it!!! We will recommend it to our friends from U.S.A, Canada and Philippines. it is always better to enter the easy or front door when arriving from the airport.
Best location possible!

The location is awesome! Quiet as it's not in the tourist area. It's convenient to take the bus or train within 5 mins walk. There are many good restaurants and gelato stores around, which have better food, better prices, compared to the food in the downtown. The food in different price ranges, just next to the apartment.
The location was perfect. Not a far walk to the beach and many shops and restaurants nearby. The take out breakfast was nice but perhaps a muffin with one fruit. It was still much appreciated
Parking was a bit far
Good breakfast and good location The room's too small
A beautiful spot in a great location (about a 5 minute drive to the Lucca city walls). The breakfast was delicious and the staff were wonderful!
Nice comfortable rooms, good continental brackfast, friendly staff

The host was very kind and helpful. Although we never met him, he was extremely helpful in advising us on where to park, eat, place to visit. Really was unexpected and a bonus the apt was very nice. The building hallways were definitely needing some update and a little rough. This had nothing to do with the actual unit, which was very clean and modern

Central location, walking distance to the Colleseum, friendly staff, always welcoming and helpful. No Kleenex in the room, very basic rooms, okay breakfast, small room for breakfast. We had to tell the staff what time we would go for breakfast the day before.

Great location. Everything is within walking distance. There is no elevator. The apartment has one bedroom downstairs and a loft upstairs, which has an open stairway. There is no AC upstairs, and the fan on cooling makes a huge racket that we couldn't keep it on. It was very hot in the loft. Lack of proper bathroom amenities. If you run out toilet roll, you have to buy them. A little hand soap in the bathroom and no holder to put it in.
Pool , facilities beautiful. The cafeteria, very confusing to order. Staff tried to help but still confusing.

The apartment is super cute and the communications are smooth despite being contactless. The location is perfect. The overall place would benefit some renovations, especially the bathroom. Everything works but the comfort is not top.

The location was great being only a few minutes away from Fiumicino. It was clean and comfortable with many restaurants nearby. The only thing I didn't like was that it was difficult to find the location because it is tucked above an orthodontist's office so the address isn't facing the street.
The breakfast was abundant and had a variety of items. The Americano coffee I requested wasn’t correct at first, but a new coffee was made.
The finest friendliest staff you will ever meet !!! Very helpful and kind, free diner and breakfast with outstanding views of the ocean form the room and pool , a must!!!
Breakfast was great but could have live station for eggs Location was perfect Room was amazing Breakfast options

The beds were comfortable! It was much quieter and calmer than staying in Venice. Easily reachable directly from venice airport and easy to get to venice proper using the 7, 4.1, 4.2. The kitchen was well stocked in terms of kitchenware. The place was very clean. Dario and Elodie were wonderful and communication was very prompt. Amenities were within easy walking distance. The physical set up is a bit odd as the 3rd bedroom is directly linked to the 2nd bedroom through stairs. This can make it difficult for people sleeping up there to go to the washroom at night without waking others and requires using stairs at night. It is also warmer on the 3rd floor despite AC - a fan would be a good idea. The TV on the 2nd floor was glitchy. These are minor things though.
Sea view, very modern room with balcony, great breakfast Hard to find parking in front of the hotel,, all the blue lines is not free, white lines are free

We had such an amazing time here. Very well thought of apartment. Very clean and has everything one needs. Would totally recommend staying here. Pamela was very helpful throughout. Great location. Close to all the restaurants. But still not noisy at all. Nothing at all.

Large living space and principle bedroom. Second bedroom is an open loft on 3rd floor. Host was responsive to requests or issues arising. Decent location, about 15 minute walk to centre. Mosquitos! Even with windows closed, got bitten in the middle of each night.

The view was great and the place was clean and well kept. The host was friendly. Ravello in general was calmer and slightly less touristy than other nearby areas. The advertisement said there was parking available, but when we got there we had to park about 15 minutes away AND pay 25 euros per day to park. Also the location has a great view, but it is a bit difficult to lug suitcases up and down the 140 stairs in the heat -- I definitely would not recommend this location to older travellers or anyone with mobility issue (or really just anyone who is not in good physical shape, lol). The beach is quite far away so not an ideal location for a beach holiday. Also the breakfast was a bit disappointing, not even fruit just some croissants and Italian Kraft singles/lunch meat ham. There also wasn't enough for everyone to take more than a couple things.

Even though the 2nd Floor room #21 that we stayed in for 2 nights between May 31st and June 2nd faced the street and elevator, the sound was not a distraction. The front desk staff were exceptional and professional and even allowed us to store baggage for a few hours after checking out until we explored a few more towns in Cinqueterre and caught our evening train to Florence. We were even given the kind offer to freshen up before retrieving our luggage in storage, which we greatly appreciated. We noticed some of the wall paper is peeling and had trouble operating the rain shower head. Otherwise, no issues.

We had a great time staying at S. Andra villa . The staff were very kind . We love the breakfast .not only the great selections of fresh foods but the patio with magnificent views . both Deborah and Aryana were like a family member with their hospitality making sure we had nice breakfast and very kind to pack a breakfast for our daughter. Both Alejandro and Phillips were great. Alejandro was also vey kind to take us to a close by restaurant when we didn’t have a car . Such a true gentleman. Many thanks to all the staff .

The hotel was beautiful, the staff was incredible except 1 person. Umberto was amazing you can tell he loves his job with how he interacts with everyone, he even got us pizza delivered on a Sunday night at 10:30 because we were starving after a long day at the Amafi's the pizza arrived in 10 mins and was only €20.00! Thank you, Grazie mille Max ! It was a wonderful stay and near everything we needed !

The views from the hotel, and the restaurant and terrace are outstanding! You see the beauty of the bay of Naples, Vesuvius and even Capri. The hotel being in an old monastery, was very unique. The only negative is I wish the pool stayed open longer, at least some of the days of the week.

Was cute looking with a nice shared patio Was a walkable distance to many areas Too many steps down from street level door to reach the advertised ground level apartment Not suitable for a disabled person The apartment was very damp and many mosquitoes

The view was very nice and surrounded by nature, I enjoyed my morning coffee while sitting outside in the garden.The staff were helpful and friendly. There were no toiletries provided, and at night, it felt a bit lonely as it was very far from the center. You need a car to go anywhere from the location.
The room is nice, the shower is very comfortable! Un joli endroit pour habiter en Ligurie! A beautiful hotel to stay in Riomaggiore! The bed is a little uncomfortable but it’s not a very big problem.

Lovely old building with beautiful views Fresh delicious breakfast with wide selection of local food Option to have dinner at the property Amazing pool with gradual entrance perfect for kids Would have liked option to eat breakfast at tables outside during June trip
walking distance to most attractions, stores, quiet, good size for 3 adults

All staff we met spoke English and were very pleasant, friendly and helpful. Room was quiet and comfortable. Extra door in room to access balcony. Location very accessible to Marco Polo Airport. No handheld shower head Small fridge in room would be beneficial as well as 2 glasses/wine glasses

Location was great, it is right in the heart of the city. Very friendly host, provided us with lots of information about sights, restaurants and shops. The rooms were clean, it has very efficient air conditioning and a lovely shared veranda with a BBQ upstairs. Not much, although more than one toilet roll would have been appreciated.

We stayed in the one bedroom and kitchen apartment, the place was modern, super clean and well equipped, full fridge, washing machine, large bathroom and bedroom. Excellent location for walking to restaurants and shopping. On site parking with electric gate. Roof top was a beautiful place to watch the sunset and meet others from the building. The owner even gave us a local liqueur drink when we arrived along with a few beers and waters. Great place to stay with fast access to many of Sardinia’s beautiful beaches. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
Clean, comfortable, convenient. AC worked, many communal spaces, and luggage storage.

We LOVED this absolutely gorgeous hotel in Taormina! And I mean gorgeous! The rooms were great and had doors that opened onto a beautiful terrace overlooking the Mediterranean, with table/chairs/loungers for each room. Very well-tended gardens all around. The interiors were decorated in "old" Italian style, lots of character. There is a lounge for drinks with high ceilings and Italian furniture, beautifully decorated. And I can't say enough about the buffet breakfast. Absolutely fantastic with so much choice, everything excellent. Cheese, salads, juices, baked goods, sweets, eggs, hot dishes, even had tiramisu! Every morning we were there (3), the breakfast offerings were slightly different which was also great. And of course, when you sit down someone comes to get your cappuccino order right away! The breakfast room had soaring ceilings and huge windows, and an adjoining sunny terrace where we ate, all with an uninterrupted view to the sea. The hotel (and all of Taormina) is built on a steep hillside, so the roads are pretty windy and steep. Bel Soggiorno is not quite in Taormina proper (which is a good thing because it can be packed with people), but it is only a short staircase up to the main part of town. You really can't get more picturesque than this place! I'd recommend staying at this well-tended hotel! It was all good!

The hotel and room was modern, clean and the room was spacious. The beds were comfortable. The air conditioning was working so well. Nice and cold and was very refreshing coming in from the heat. Love that there were small supplies in the bathroom which included a toothbrush, toothpaste, Kleenex, needle and thread and other little urgent supplies was very nice. 10/10 for that. I would stay again. Thank you to Davide at the roof top bar who had a big smile and took pride in making the drinks so perfect! Plenty of ice! Which we love. Plus the complimentary snacks with the apparatif was so delightful. The bar was clean and Nice and cold. Made us want to stay longer. Overall this was our last hotel during our time in Italy and it left us with a wonderful impression. Great location close to the train station. Front desk staff and housekeeping staff friendly and helpful. Thank you and hope to return again soon. I would have preferred breakfast included , didn’t know that was an option. Other than that, no complaints.
the staff was very friendly and the location was nice not having AC was brutal in the summer, the bed was not comfortable at all, alot of stairs to get to my room, ants in my room

Convenient location, walking distance to many sites, and easy access to any type of public transportation. Loads of restaurants and stores in the neighborhood. Lack of communication. The room was not ready until 7 p.m..

Great Location and the breakfast was a very nice surprise. Delicious and fresh. Our room's view was not great. It just looked at the room of the next building. Might have been nicer on the courtside of the building.

They left an adequate breakfast in the room, although there were no dining facilities. Two brioches, two yoghurts, lots of coffee. Much better than having to drive somewhere This was a lovely place in a lovely, charming, magical region. The hosts were perfect. Unlike most people who come here, I imagine, I needed to work a bit, and the room was not quite set up for that, although I made it work. The next time they rethink hotel decor the owners might consider a simple desk and chair arrangement.

A perfect stay, the most amazing view and everything you need is within a couple mins walk, if that. Very kind and accommodating staff who are very friendly and happy to make your stay smooth and enjoyable. We would definitely stay again.
Caffe Fiori amazing .Matuas and Valeria at the coffee very pleasant and friendly I will miss them

The location and facilities are amazing! The place is clean and comfortable and the view of the beach and town is beautiful! Its very convenient to both Atrani and Amalfi with easy port access to most of the Amalfi coast, and the bus routes to ravello and positano. The apartment exceeded our expectations and had everything you would need and more. Loved having access to a washer and dryer. Also, parking was available and easy to access. The customer service was friendly and very helpful. We would highly recommend this accommodation to anyone thinking of staying in Catania. Great access to historical landmarks, restaurants and more. 10+ There was a "tourist go away' sign' on the Rotunda historical site across the street.

Location was fantastic, tucked in a quiet laneway. The breakfast room was large and had an amazing selection. The room was clean, modern and had a terrace overlooking the sea and town. Beach towels were provided in the room. The room was not large but fine as we didn't spend a ton of time in room. The hotel had an amazing terraced garden overlooking the sea and town. You could grab a drink from the bar in the afternoon and sit at a table or lounger in the garden and listen to the waves, birds, bullfrogs and church bells. Was idyllic. Have nothing negative to say, was a great hotel. Room wasn't particularly large and bathroom was small but room was clean and room service provided fresh towels each day. We loved Monterosso the best of the 5 villages. Lovely walking around in the evening and found wonderful restaurants each night.
Such a unique stay, beautiful property and lovely people. The breakfast was the best we’ve had in Sardinia, lots of fresh local options. Dinner also great! Would highly recommend.
Clean, comfortable, affordable, and modern. GREAT AC and Wifi Good breakfast

The beautiful young lady who was our hostess was so delightful and informative. She was so knowledgeable about the area and happenings on in the town. Her family owned the hotel and it was so refreshing to see someone that passionate about her job, family and the town! Free parking is always a bonus and same with the lovely complimentary breakfast served. Our rooms were nice, clean, and very spacious! Absolutely perfect stay! The villa near Pompeii’s volcano was spotless, comfortable, and in an amazing location. Everything was exactly as described. The Location is amazing! It's walking distance to all attractions and plenty of restaurants around the hotel! The host was very helpful and was easy to reach. The room was cleaned daily and the staff on site were very helpful as well. Overall we had a wonderful stay 😊

The hotel is very centrally located, within walking distance of many major attractions and main streets. Only a 15-20 minute walk from the train station. Our rooms were very clean, well-furnished, with a spacious bathroom and very comfortable beds. I had to check-in after hours and the hotel staff made the process very easy and convenient for me. The room was fitted with first rate furniture and fittings, the breakfast was very good, though not hot with bacon and omelette. The owners were extremely helpful and gracious For us oldies an elevator would be nice

It is situated in an alley but on a great strip of restaurants and stores. The apartment is walking distance to anywhere you would like to visit. I would highly recommend this property and the price was good. We had absolutely no issues and we were two women and felt really safe.

The apartment is located super close to the historical part of Matera. It is very clean and offers everything one may need for the stay. Good location and spacious apartment. Communication with the host is smooth and easy. The beds are comfortable, and the rooms are clean. The AC is in the living room only.

Really can't go wrong with this place. Right in the center of all the attractions, room was clean and large, breakfast was perfect with the outdoor patio looking at the arena. Great value for your money! Staff was also super helpful with suggestions for sightseeing. Nothing

We loved this small B&B. Our host Alvise was so friendly and helpful - he shared so much information about the city and how to get around. Our room was lovely, very comfortable and quiet. The location was perfect to walk out the door and head to restaurants, museums, tours, etc. The continental breakfast was served in our room and was very good.

This summer, my family and I (my wife and our two daughters, ages 12 and 14) had the absolute pleasure of staying at Calipso Residence in Furore, Italy—and it was nothing short of magical. From the moment we arrived, we were captivated by the breathtaking view overlooking the Amalfi Coast. The property itself was immaculate: spacious, beautifully maintained, and thoughtfully designed to make you feel instantly at home. The large kitchen and living area were perfect for those quiet moments when we simply wanted to soak in the scenery and enjoy the serenity of the space. The location was ideal—peaceful and perched above the coast, yet just a bus ride down to the vibrant towns and beaches below. It offered the best of both worlds: tranquility and accessibility. But what truly made our stay unforgettable was Leopoldo, the owner. His warmth, generosity, and genuine hospitality made us feel like part of his family. It’s rare to find someone who not only shares their home but also their heart. Leopoldo, thank you and your family for making our experience so special. A presto, Leopoldo! We’ll carry the memories of Calipso Residence with us always.

- clean - location - felt safe - fast respond with host - not what we booked : we were suppose to have 1 bedroom and 1 living room, we had 1 room with 2 beds. The host offered me to leave if I wasn't happy. We chose to stay because what you find on such short notice.

The apartment was perfect — very clean, well-equipped, and ideally located just 25 minutes walking from the Colosseum. The host was extremely kind and attentive, regularly checking in to make sure everything was going well.

We stayed in Room 410, close to the elevator, and overlooking a greenspace and the west side of the train station. Any sound was muffled, overridden by the "white sound" of the powerful air conditioning system which kept us comfortable on a 30C hot day and evening. Great location within easy walking distance of Milan Central train station. Good breakfast and pleasant, helpful staff at the front desk and front door. They'll get a cab, recommend a food store and suggest good restaurants.This upbeat hotel had chique decor and always played quiet music in the hallways. Good air conditioning, clean room, and bathroom. You can walk (35 minutes) or take a cab (15-20 minutes) to the Duomo a few kms away. If using the yellow subway line to get to the Duomo piazza be aware for the ever present lurking pick pockets. Overall, a very comfortable 2 night stay. Be aware there are 15 or so stairs up to the front entrance door, and no ramp we could see. A staff member may be present to help with bags in or out the front door and up/down the stairs. Also, be aware of curved stairs leading to the 2 main floor elevator entrances at the front door. With or without bags, a misstep could result in slips,trips, or falls. There is another set of elevators adjacent to reception with no steps and a flat floor that guests can use.

The location is not bad, on the one end of Niccolo Piccini Road, where is near to the garden. From the airport to the center, it is the first stop, close to the place. To lock yourself in the room using a key when go to bed.

The view is the best part of this property. While we didn't have a private balcony, our room was at the farthest end from the restaurant terrace, so we were able to sit outside with relative privacy. Among the staff, Lorena (the owner) was particularly welcoming and kind. In the morning, she would give activity suggestions and can set you up with discounted Cinque Terre passes. Her presence was a huge positive factor for my overall mixed review. The complimentary cake and tea/coffee served in the morning was nice and a peaceful setting. Proximity to train station made traveling between towns very convenient. An added note, the climb up to the property is completely fine for anyone with average fitness levels. We had carry on suitcases and did not struggle. The room size and nearby train station noise really detracts from the experience. It's hard to relax in your room as there's only room for 1 bed and nothing else. Your ability to tolerate the train noise will also depend on each person - I live in a city near subways/public transportation and found the regular train noise not too jarring, however any of the high speed trains coming through were very noticeable. Additionally, the thin curtains let in too much light in the mornings. Bathrooms were average, but some details were overlooked - for example, a cleaning bottle was left hanging on the towel hook upon check in and shower grout was in need of a deep clean. The water pressure was, unfortunately, non existent. Lastly, I really struggled with the communication with Sara, who manages the whatsapp communications (needed for checking in). I had an unauthorized charge on my credit card from the property months before check in that was outside of the rate fee. I tried to follow up multiple times to resolve the issue, but was largely ignored. Trying to resolve it in person was also to no avail. Ultimately, I had to let my bank handle it after my trip ended as I didn't want to risk my reservation being impacted before arrival. The lack of professionalism in this case ended up casting a negative shadow across the whole experience, therefore I can't recommend staying.

The location was great, close to the Roma Termini, within walking distance of most of the main attractions and many good restaurants and amenities nearby. The noise. The booking description stated that is was close to the rail station (Roma Termini ?) and you could experience some rail noise. Looking on Google Maps this was correct, we decided that we could put up with some noise from the trains in exchange for the excellent location. What it didn't clarify is that the reference is to 2 tram lines which run directly under your windows on 2 sides of the room. The trams run every 5 to 10 minutes from 05:30 to 24:00 and are very noisy. it made it necessary to sleep with earplugs which are not very comfortable. The last suggestion would be to mount the shower head on the wall which will make it much easier to shower without having water spraying outside the tub and on the floor.

We spent a month in Italy, beginning and ending in Venice. Of course, if you are visiting Venice you should stay in the historical heart of it, which we did at the beginning of our trip. However, for our last 2 nights in Italy, we stayed at Ca Tessera because our flight home was due to leave at 6:00 am, meaning we would have to get to the airport by about 3:30 AM. So instead of staying in Venice for our last 2 nights, we decided to stay out near the airport which was a VERY GOOD decision. This hotel was excellent for this purpose! The facilities were great, it was quiet, very friendly staff and it was quite picturesque too. And I think they know that most people who stay here do so because they have to get to the airport (there are several hotels in the area). So they have an excellent shuttle service that will get you to and from the airport any time (book it the day before at the front desk), only 10-15 minutes away. And they had some breakfast items ready that early too. Also, because we did have 1 full day left in Italy, we wanted to go into Venice. It was VERY easy to catch a nearby bus that zoomed right to Venice, and it was easy and quick to get back to the hotel. Not complicated. And the staff can tell you how to do it easily. So if you are flying out of Venice airport and want to stay only a 10 minute shuttle ride away, this is a very good choice! Might have been nice to have drinks available to purchase on site, since they do have a very nice lounge and outdoor sitting space.
Beautiful, well located place with lots of room. Highly recommended One of the beds was a little uncomfortable, the one in the spare room off of kitchen.

The location was very good, just outside of the walls of the city, which meant about a 15-minute walk into the city itself (or 10 if you just want to stroll along the wall). Would have enjoyed eggs, bacon and sausage for breakfast. Room was a little warm for sleeping even with oscillating fan due to lack of a/c. Did not find taxi from train station so had to lug suitcases a few hundred meters to the facility, over cobblestone roadways so was tiring and a little frustrating.

Room decore needed a little update.

Very Clean 36 stairs up and 4 different access doors! (Definitely not explained well that the rooms are All/ONLY on the top floor). The place has really "cute" decorating (everything matches) yet very awkward to live in and not functional for people who travel (we need flat surfaces to put our stuff on: the only super small shelf in the bathroom can fit a toothpaste, brush + the provided plastic cup and soap (need a proper sized shelf/vanity/something flat and waterproof near the sink); the narrow table for coffee/tea/cups is way too narrow to add anything else (the 'nespresso machine has to be on an angle); only small/short stool (nowhere to lay down clothes or for a grown man to sit properly). The bed is really where you have to sit and ideally not just 3 fat/ puffy bed pillows (both of us got a sore neck). The " cute" black bar fridge compressor turns on/off loudly (irritating to sleep with) and as others have indicated, the bathroom fan noise level which goes on with the light can 'wake the dead'. No glasses - only 2 coffee cups/saucers and very small paper cups (horrible to drink wine/beer from:) There are 2 small nightstands - small again - as is the area to hang clothes (the hangars have to go on an angle to fit). So all in all, it is an awkward space to stay in even with small travel bags (they of course end up on the floor)- at one point I used the toilet lid and bidet for holding my coffee! Oh, 6+ coffee pods yet 3 fake creamers for 2 nights:( Even if the owner got 2 folding luggage racks, that would assist in staying organized. Yes, the shower is normal-Italy size yet tough for a real-sized person to have a good shower. (BTW run both the shower heads before you get in to warm the water in all the pipes). The fact that the owner insists on a 2 night MIN stay meant we were committed or lost money.

Nice hotel next to the beach, staff are very welcoming, the room are comfortable and clean, swimming pool was not cold and very clean Breakfast, there was everything and was good! Free parking next to the hotel.

In the Navigli district — A short walk to many restaurants and bars. Quiet but dark. Honest Review – 3/5 I don’t usually write reviews — but felt this was important to share. It's only fair to help others get a better sense of what they're paying for. We’re a family of four (traveling with two children under 12), Location: In the Navigli district — great for nightlife and canal-side restaurants. However, if your interests are visiting Milan’s main sights (Duomo, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Sforzesco Castle, or the main shopping area), staying closer to the city center is more practical. The metro is approximately 20-minute walk away. While the tram is nearby, it wasn’t very convenient due to ongoing construction and street closures. The Unit (2-Bedroom Loft): The unit has A/C, but it’s placed too low to cool the loft area where the beds are. As heat rises, sleeping upstairs was uncomfortably hot and stuffy. A fan was placed in 1 bedroom but wasn't much help. The furnishings and bedding are all IKEA. Sheets were rough, and the only blanket provided was a thick wool-blend — far too heavy for July. Comfort & Amenities: All pillows were firm foam — not ideal for long stays or for those who prefer softer options. A mix would be appreciated. No hooks anywhere — Nowhere to hang your purse, sweater, or towels. Bathroom amenities--hand soap made available but seemed like shampoo/body wash was left from a previous guest. No tissues or Kleenex provided. Kitchen was stocked with basic cookware, plates, and utensils, but lacked a microwave and dishwasher. Even for simple reheats, you need to use the stove. It was quiet —However, the overall vibe inside the unit could feel a bit eerie at times, especially with kids; something to keep in mind. Overall: This place has potential, but needs improvement in comfort, layout and attention to detail. For now, rating it a 3 out of 5.
